test_cases.title: Start of Mission tetikleyicisi ile oturum kurulumu
test_cases.preconditions: OBU Level 2 modunda yapılandırılmıştır. RBC erişilebilir durumdadır.

steps.action: Start of Mission (SoM) prosedürü başlatılır.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma sürecini başlatır.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumunun tamamlanması beklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile güvenli radyo bağlantısını kurar ve oturum 'established' durumuna geçer.

test_cases.title: Radyo deliğinin sonuna varışta oturum kurulumu
test_cases.preconditions: Tren, bildirilmiş bir radyo deliğinden (announced radio hole) geçmektedir. OBU Level 2'dedir.

steps.action: Trenin arka ucu (engine rear end), radyo deliğinin sonuna ulaşır.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile yeni bir iletişim oturumu kurma sürecini başlatır.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumunun tamamlanması beklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile güvenli radyo bağlantısını kurar ve oturum 'established' durumuna geçer.

test_cases.title: Manuel Level 2 değişiminde oturum kurulumu
test_cases.preconditions: OBU Level 1 veya başka bir seviyededir. RBC erişilebilir durumdadır.

steps.action: Sürücü, seviyeyi manuel olarak Level 2'ye değiştirir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma sürecini başlatır.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumunun tamamlanması beklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile güvenli radyo bağlantısını kurar ve oturum 'established' durumuna geçer.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulum sıralaması ve hata yönetimi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile oturum kurma tetikleyicisiyle karşı karşıyadır. RBC uyumlu bir sistem sürümüne sahiptir.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu başlatılır.
steps.expected: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için istek (request) gönderir.

steps.action: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulduktan sonra 'Initiation of communication session' mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, 'Initiation of communication session' mesajını RBC'ye iletir.

steps.action: RBC'den sistem sürümü (system version) mesajı alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, oturumu 'established' olarak kabul eder ve 'session established report' mesajını gönderir.

test_cases.title: Uyumlu olmayan sistem sürümü durumunda oturum sonlandırma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile oturum kurma tetikleyicisiyle karşı karşıyadır. RBC, OBU ile uyumlu olmayan bir sistem sürümüne sahiptir.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu başlatılır ve güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulur.
steps.expected: OBU, 'Initiation of communication session' mesajını gönderir.

steps.action: RBC'den uyumlu olmayan bir sistem sürümü mesajı alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, 'No compatible version supported' mesajını gönderir, sürücüye bilgi verir ve oturumu sonlandırır.

test_cases.title: Radyo sistemi seçimi: Trackside emri önceliği
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem FRMCS hem GSM-R radyo sistemleri mevcuttur. Trackside, FRMCS-only RBC'ye bağlanma emri gönderir.

steps.action: Trackside'dan FRMCS-only RBC'ye bağlanma emri alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için FRMCS radyo sistemini kullanır.

test_cases.title: Radyo sistemi seçimi: Sürücü tercihi önceliği
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem FRMCS hem GSM-R radyo sistemleri mevcuttur. Trackside emri yoktur. SoM sırasında sürücü sadece GSM-R kullanmayı seçmiştir.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu başlatılır.
steps.expected: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için GSM-R radyo sistemini kullanır.

test_cases.title: Radyo sistemi seçimi: Kayıtlı ağ bilgisi önceliği
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem FRMCS hem GSM-R radyo sistemleri mevcuttur. Trackside emri yoktur. Sürücü tek radyo tercihi yapmamıştır. Kayıtlı Radio Network type 'FRMCS+GSM-R' ve önceki oturumda FRMCS kullanılmıştır.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu başlatılır.
steps.expected: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için FRMCS radyo sistemini kullanır (önceki oturumda tercih edilen sistem).

test_cases.title: Başarılı radyo sisteminin hafızaya kaydedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem FRMCS hem GSM-R radyo sistemleri mevcuttur. Oturum kurulumu başlatılmıştır.

steps.action: OBU, GSM-R radyo sistemi üzerinden güvenli radyo bağlantısını başarıyla kurar.
steps.expected: OBU, başarılı bağlantı için kullanılan radyo sistemini (GSM-R) hafızasına kaydeder.

steps.action: Oturum sonlandırılır ve yeni bir oturum kurulumu başlatılır (trackside emri veya sürücü tercihi yoksa).
steps.expected: OBU, yeni oturum için önceki oturumda kullanılan GSM-R sistemini tercih eder.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu sırasında End of Mission ile sonlandırma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma sürecindedir (güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulmuş, sistem sürümü bekleniyor).

steps.action: Sürücü, End of Mission (EoM) prosedürünü başlatır.
steps.expected: OBU, oturum kurulumunu sonlandırır (abort) ve mevcut güvenli radyo bağlantısını serbest bırakır (release).

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu sırasında Level 2 sınır geçişi ile sonlandırma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma sürecindedir. Tren, Level 2 desteklenmeyen bir alana doğru hareket etmektedir.

steps.action: Trenin minimum güvenli arka ucu (min safe rear end), Level 2 alanından Level 2 desteklenmeyen alana geçiş sınırını (level transition border) geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, oturum kurulumunu sonlandırır (abort) ve mevcut güvenli radyo bağlantısını serbest bırakır (release).

test_cases.title: Son bilinen RBC emri ile oturum kurulumu (kayıtlı bilgi mevcut)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da RBC iletişim bilgileri (telefon numarası vb.) kayıtlıdır. Trackside, 'last known RBC' özel kimlik değerini içeren bir oturum kurma emri gönderir.

steps.action: Trackside'dan 'last known RBC' emri alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, emirdeki telefon numarasını yok sayar ve kayıtlı RBC iletişim bilgilerini kullanarak RBC'ye bağlanır.

test_cases.title: Son bilinen RBC emri ile oturum kurulumu (kayıtlı bilgi yok)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da RBC iletişim bilgileri kayıtlı değildir. Trackside, 'last known RBC' özel kimlik değerini içeren bir oturum kurma emri gönderir.

steps.action: Trackside'dan 'last known RBC' emri alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, emri yok sayar (ignore) ve oturum kurma işlemi başlatmaz.

test_cases.title: OBU does not open a second session with the same RBC while the first is being established
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A session establishment process with RBC-A is in progress (e.g., GSM-R connection is being set up).
test_cases.test_inputs: A second trigger for session establishment with RBC-A (e.g., driver selects 'Start' again or a trackside order is received).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs session establishment attempts and status.

steps.action: Initiate the first session establishment with RBC-A.
steps.expected: The OBU begins the process of establishing a communication session with RBC-A.

steps.action: While the first session is still being established, trigger a second session establishment request with the same RBC-A.
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate a new, separate session establishment process with RBC-A. The existing process continues or is handled according to internal logic, but no duplicate concurrent session setup is started.

test_cases.title: OBU terminates existing session with other RBCs when establishing a new one
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has an established communication session with RBC-A. An order to connect to RBC-B is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Order to establish session with RBC-B.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC-A and RBC-B are distinct entities. The OBU supports multiple sessions or handles transition as per spec.

steps.action: Receive an order to establish a communication session with RBC-B while a session with RBC-A is active.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the session status with RBC-A and RBC-B.
steps.expected: The session with RBC-A is terminated (Termination of Communication Session message sent or equivalent action taken). The OBU proceeds to establish a new session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: OBU does not terminate session with supervising RBC during RBC transition to Accepting RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in session with RBC-A (supervising). An RBC transition order is received indicating RBC-B is the Accepting RBC. The OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions or the specific exception applies.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order with embedded order to establish session with Accepting RBC-B.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is configured to support the exception described in SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.5.2.1.

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order that includes an order to establish a session with the Accepting RBC (RBC-B).
steps.expected: The OBU does not terminate the existing session with the currently supervising RBC (RBC-A).

steps.action: Observe the session status with RBC-A and the initiation of session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The session with RBC-A remains active. The OBU begins establishing a session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates balise information validity based on crossing direction in Sleeping mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Sleeping (SL) mode. The train is moving in the nominal direction. A balise group is encountered that contains information valid only for the reverse direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise data valid for reverse direction only.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is physically crossing the balise group in the nominal direction.

steps.action: Cross a balise group in the nominal direction while in Sleeping mode. The balise contains information marked as valid only for the reverse direction.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information because it is valid only for the opposite direction relative to the crossing direction.

steps.action: Cross a balise group in the nominal direction while in Sleeping mode. The balise contains information marked as valid for both directions.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the information into account.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates balise information validity based on crossing direction in Shunting mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Shunting (SH) mode. The train is moving in the reverse direction. A balise group is encountered that contains information valid only for the nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise data valid for nominal direction only.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is physically crossing the balise group in the reverse direction.

steps.action: Cross a balise group in the reverse direction while in Shunting mode. The balise contains information marked as valid only for the nominal direction.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information because it is valid only for the opposite direction relative to the crossing direction.

steps.action: Cross a balise group in the reverse direction while in Shunting mode. The balise contains information marked as valid for the reverse direction.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the information into account.

test_cases.title: OBU keeps applying last received MA request parameters until new ones are received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has received MA request parameters from RBC (e.g., repetition period = 10s). No new parameters have been received since.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time elapse of 10 seconds.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is in a state where MA requests are triggered by timer.

steps.action: Wait for the defined repetition period (10s) to elapse since the last MA request.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Wait for another repetition period (10s) to elapse.
steps.expected: The OBU sends another MA request, using the same parameters as before.

test_cases.title: OBU sends MA request immediately if time since last request exceeds new repetition period
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has been using MA request parameters with a repetition period of 10s. The last MA request was sent 12 seconds ago. New MA request parameters are received with a repetition period of 10s.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters (repetition period = 10s).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can monitor the time since the last MA request.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC with a repetition period of 10s, while the time since the last MA request is 12s.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately sends an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: OBU does not define Supervised Location while supervising a Limit of Authority
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a Movement Authority with a Limit of Authority (LOA) where the target speed is above zero. There are potential SvL candidates (e.g., end of overlap) within the MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement towards the LOA.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs or exposes the current Supervised Location (SvL) status.

steps.action: Move the train towards the Limit of Authority while it is being supervised.
steps.expected: The OBU does not define any Supervised Location (SvL) on board. None of the SvL candidates (end of overlap, Danger Point, end of End Section) are used as SvL.

test_cases.title: Level 1 signalling related speed restriction remains valid until new one is received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. A signalling related speed restriction of 50 km/h has been received and is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time elapse without new speed restriction.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU displays or logs the active speed restriction.

steps.action: Wait for a period of time without receiving a new signalling related speed restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply the 50 km/h speed restriction.

steps.action: Receive a new signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the 50 km/h restriction with the 80 km/h restriction immediately upon receipt.

test_cases.title: Level 1 signalling related speed restriction remains valid after switching to Level 2 until Level 2 MA is accepted
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 with an active signalling related speed restriction of 50 km/h. The OBU switches to Level 2.
test_cases.test_inputs: Switch to Level 2. No Level 2 MA received yet.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can switch levels and track the status of MA acceptance.

steps.action: Switch the OBU from Level 1 to Level 2 while the 50 km/h signalling related speed restriction is active.
steps.expected: The 50 km/h speed restriction remains valid.

steps.action: Accept a Level 2 Movement Authority (MA).
steps.expected: The signalling related speed restriction is no longer applied (or is replaced by the Level 2 MA constraints).

test_cases.title: OBU handles Maximum Train Speed as a Static Speed Restriction category
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is configured with a Maximum Train Speed value (e.g., 200 km/h) based on train performance.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed approaching 200 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU enforces speed limits based on static speed restrictions.

steps.action: Accelerate the train towards the configured Maximum Train Speed (200 km/h).
steps.expected: The OBU treats the Maximum Train Speed as a static speed restriction and prevents the train from exceeding 200 km/h.

test_cases.title: OBU uses 'no speed restriction' as initial state for permitted braking distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where no speed restrictions have been computed from trackside data (initial state).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU calculates permitted braking distance based on active speed restrictions.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's speed supervision logic before any speed restriction is received from trackside.
steps.expected: The OBU does not apply any permitted-braking-distance limit based on speed restrictions. The train speed is not constrained by a 'no speed restriction' limit in the context of braking distance calculation.

test_cases.title: Immediate reconnection attempt upon radio loss
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection was previously set up via GSM-R (or the specific active radio system).
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection signal from EURORADIO.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio system used for the initial connection is available and functional for reconnection.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection via EURORADIO indication.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately initiates a request to set up a new safe radio connection using the same radio system as the previous successful connection.

steps.action: Allow the reconnection process to complete successfully.
steps.expected: A new safe radio connection is established, and the communication session is maintained.

test_cases.title: Repeated reconnection attempts until success
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated radio interference causing initial reconnection failures, followed by restored signal.
test_cases.assumptions: The session termination timer has not expired, and the train has not passed the RIU termination location.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts attempting to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate a failure in the first reconnection attempt (e.g., no response from trackside).
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the attempt to set up the safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate a failure in the second reconnection attempt.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the attempt to set up the safe radio connection again.

steps.action: Restore radio signal quality to allow a successful connection.
steps.expected: The OBU successfully establishes the safe radio connection and stops repeating the attempts.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when session is terminated by timeout
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated persistent radio loss exceeding the defined session maintenance time.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined time for considering the session terminated is known and configurable or observable in the test environment.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts attempting to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Maintain the radio loss condition until the defined time for session termination expires.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session as terminated.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's reconnection behavior after the session is considered terminated.
steps.expected: The OBU stops the specific reconnection attempts for the terminated session (as per 3.5.4.3, attempts stop when session is considered terminated).

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is lost. An RIU order to terminate the communication session at a specific location is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated radio loss and train movement passing the specified RIU location.
test_cases.assumptions: The RIU order location is ahead of the train's current position.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts attempting to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Move the train to pass the location indicated in the RIU order to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU stops the attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Termination initiated by explicit trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established between the OBU and the RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: A 'Termination of communication session' order message from the RBC.

steps.action: Send a 'Termination of communication session' order from the RBC to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination procedure by sending a 'Termination of communication session' message to the RBC.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's radio traffic after sending the termination message.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send any further messages until an acknowledgement is received or the timeout/repetition logic is triggered.

test_cases.title: Termination initiated by internal condition without trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. A condition requiring termination (e.g., loss of valid movement authority or specific mode transition defined in SUBSET-026) is triggered internally.
test_cases.test_inputs: Internal trigger for termination condition (e.g., simulate loss of MA or specific state change).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific internal condition is one of those defined in SUBSET-026 as requiring termination without explicit trackside order.

steps.action: Trigger the internal termination condition on the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination procedure by sending a 'Termination of communication session' message to the RBC, despite no explicit order being received from trackside.

test_cases.title: No termination initiated without valid trigger
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. No termination order is received and no internal termination condition is met.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (normal operation continues).

steps.action: Allow the system to operate normally for a duration exceeding the fixed waiting time without any termination triggers.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send a 'Termination of communication session' message. The session remains active.

test_cases.title: Repetition of Termination message upon missing acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has initiated termination and sent the first 'Termination of communication session' message. The RBC is configured to not send an acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (RBC silence).
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time T_wait and repetition count N are known from Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time T_wait after the first 'Termination of communication session' message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a second 'Termination of communication session' message.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time T_wait after the second message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a third 'Termination of communication session' message.

test_cases.title: Session considered terminated after max repetitions without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in the process of terminating a session. It has already sent the 'Termination of communication session' message the defined number of times (N). The RBC has not sent an acknowledgement for any of these messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (RBC silence).
test_cases.assumptions: The defined number of repetitions N is known from Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time T_wait after the N-th (last) 'Termination of communication session' message.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session terminated. The internal state of the OBU reflects that the session is no longer active.

steps.action: Attempt to send a new message that requires an active session (if applicable) or observe the session state indicator.
steps.expected: The OBU does not attempt to maintain the session or send further termination messages. The session state is 'Terminated'.

test_cases.title: No repetition if acknowledgement is received within waiting time
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has initiated termination and sent the first 'Termination of communication session' message.
test_cases.test_inputs: An 'Acknowledgement of termination of communication session' message from the RBC.

steps.action: Send an 'Acknowledgement of termination of communication session' from the RBC before the fixed waiting time T_wait expires.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the acknowledgement. The OBU does not send any further 'Termination of communication session' messages.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobile Terminal registration at power-up
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered off. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected and powered on. The GSM-R Radio Network is available.

steps.action: Power on the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the registration process for the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the GSM-R Radio Network.

steps.action: Monitor the status of the GSM-R Mobile Terminal.
steps.expected: The GSM-R Mobile Terminal becomes registered to the GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobile Terminal registration after driver enters new identity
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and operational. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected. The current GSM-R Radio Network identity is different from the one to be entered.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid new GSM-R Radio Network identity.

steps.action: Driver enters a new GSM-R Radio Network identity into the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new identity and initiates the registration process for the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the new GSM-R Radio Network.

steps.action: Monitor the status of the GSM-R Mobile Terminal.
steps.expected: The GSM-R Mobile Terminal becomes registered to the new GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobile Terminal registration when ordered by trackside
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and operational. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected but not registered to the target GSM-R Radio Network. The Mobile Terminal is not used for an established communication session and no safe radio connection is being set up.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Radio Network transition order from trackside specifying the target GSM-R Radio Network.

steps.action: Send a Radio Network transition order from trackside to the OBU specifying the target GSM-R Radio Network.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the Radio Network type and immediately orders the registration of the GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the specified GSM-R Radio Network.

steps.action: Monitor the status of the GSM-R Mobile Terminal.
steps.expected: The GSM-R Mobile Terminal becomes registered to the specified GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: Use of default Radio Network type after System Failure
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. A System Failure occurs, causing the loss of the memorised Radio Network type. No new Radio Network type has been received from trackside or entered by the driver.
test_cases.assumptions: The default Radio Network type is configured on-board.

steps.action: Trigger a System Failure that clears the memorised Radio Network type.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the absence of a memorised Radio Network type.

steps.action: Observe the Radio Network type used by the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the default Radio Network type configured on-board.

test_cases.title: Use of default Radio Network type at very first power-up
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered off. No Radio Network type has ever been memorised (very first power-up).
test_cases.assumptions: The default Radio Network type is configured on-board.

steps.action: Power on the OBU for the very first time.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the absence of a memorised Radio Network type.

steps.action: Observe the Radio Network type used by the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the default Radio Network type configured on-board.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when FRMCS not registered (FRMCS only installed)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Only FRMCS is installed on-board. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS. The FRMCS on-board is not registered to the FRMCS Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when FRMCS not registered (FRMCS+GSM-R, both installed, no single-radio choice)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed on-board. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. The driver has not elected to perform the mission with only one radio system. The FRMCS on-board is not registered to the FRMCS Radio Network. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when GSM-R not registered (FRMCS+GSM-R, both installed, no single-radio choice)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed on-board. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. The driver has not elected to perform the mission with only one radio system. The FRMCS on-board is registered to the FRMCS Radio Network. No GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when selected radio system not registered (FRMCS+GSM-R, both installed, single-radio choice)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed on-board. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. The driver has elected to perform the mission with only one radio system (e.g., FRMCS). The selected FRMCS on-board is no longer registered to the FRMCS Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when GSM-R not registered (GSM-R only installed)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Only GSM-R is installed on-board. The stored Radio Network type is GSM-R. No GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request for RIU when GSM-R not registered
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected but not duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RIU.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RIU.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Initial indication status is No Connection
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in a state where no safe radio connection has been established.

steps.action: Observe the driver display for the safe radio connection status.
steps.expected: The indication status is 'No Connection'.

test_cases.title: Indication status changes to Connection Up upon successful setup
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in 'No Connection' state. A valid RBC/RIU is available and reachable.

steps.action: Initiate the procedure to set up a safe radio connection with the RBC/RIU.
steps.expected: The OBU sends the request to set up the connection.

steps.action: Wait for the safe radio connection to be successfully established.
steps.expected: The indication status changes to 'Connection Up'.

test_cases.title: Connection status timer starts on first request
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in 'No Connection' state. No connection status timer is running.
test_cases.assumptions: The internal state of the 'connection status' timer is observable via test interface or logs.

steps.action: Trigger the first request to set up a safe radio connection (e.g., start of mission procedure).
steps.expected: The 'connection status' timer starts counting.

test_cases.title: Connection status timer stops when requests are stopped
test_cases.preconditions: The 'connection status' timer is running. The OBU is attempting to set up a connection.
test_cases.assumptions: The internal state of the 'connection status' timer is observable via test interface or logs.

steps.action: Stop the requests to set up the safe radio connection (e.g., abort the setup procedure for a reason other than successful setup).
steps.expected: The 'connection status' timer stops.

test_cases.title: Transition to Connection Lost/Set-Up failed on timer expiry
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in 'No Connection' state. The 'connection status' timer is running.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'connection status' timer duration is known and can be waited for or accelerated in test environment.

steps.action: Allow the 'connection status' timer to expire without the connection being established.
steps.expected: The indication status changes to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Transition to Connection Lost/Set-Up failed on connection loss with stopped requests
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in 'Connection Up' state with a relevant RBC/RIU.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the loss.

steps.action: Ensure that requests to set up the safe radio connection are stopped for a reason other than successful setup (e.g., no further attempts are made).
steps.expected: The indication status changes to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Indication status reflects current RIU in infill area
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has safe radio connections with multiple RIUs. The train is moving through an infill area.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can identify the 'current infill area' based on location data.

steps.action: Move the train into an infill area served by RIU-A. Ensure the safe radio connection with RIU-A is established.
steps.expected: The indication status shows 'Connection Up' for the safe radio connection with RIU-A.

steps.action: Move the train into an adjacent infill area served by RIU-B. Ensure the safe radio connection with RIU-B is established and RIU-A is released.
steps.expected: The indication status shows 'Connection Up' for the safe radio connection with RIU-B, reflecting the current infill area.

test_cases.title: LRBG geçişinde geçersiz konumun silinmesi ve geçerli konumun saklanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, tren konumunun 'geçersiz' (invalid) olduğunu raporlamaktadır. Geçersiz bir tren konumu bellekte saklanmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: LRBG geçiş sinyali.

steps.action: Trenin LRBG'yi geçtiği simüle edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, geçerli bir tren konumunun saklandığını kabul eder.

steps.action: Sistem belleğindeki tren konumu durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Önceki geçersiz tren konumu silinmiş olmalı ve yeni konum 'geçerli' (valid) statüsünde olmalıdır.

test_cases.title: ORBG geçişinde geçersiz konumun silinmesi ve geçerli konumun saklanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, tren konumunun 'geçersiz' (invalid) olduğunu raporlamaktadır. Geçersiz bir tren konumu bellekte saklanmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: ORBG geçiş sinyali.

steps.action: Trenin ORBG'yi geçtiği simüle edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, geçerli bir tren konumunun saklandığını kabul eder.

steps.action: Sistem belleğindeki tren konumu durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Önceki geçersiz tren konumu silinmiş olmalı ve yeni konum 'geçerli' (valid) statüsünde olmalıdır.

test_cases.title: Konum bilinmiyor (unknown) iken LRBG geçişinde konum güncellemesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, tren konumunun 'bilinmiyor' (unknown) olduğunu raporlamaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: LRBG geçiş sinyali.

steps.action: Trenin LRBG'yi geçtiği simüle edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, geçerli bir tren konumunun saklandığını kabul eder.

steps.action: Sistem belleğindeki tren konumu durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Tren konumu 'geçerli' (valid) statüsüne geçmelidir.

test_cases.title: Aktif kabin varken tren yönünün aktif kabine göre belirlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Trenin iki kabini vardır. Kabin A aktif, Kabin B pasiftir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kabin A aktif durumu.

steps.action: Tren yönü (orientation) parametresi sorgulanır.
steps.expected: Tren yönü, aktif olan Kabin A'nın tarafına göre tanımlanmış olmalıdır.

test_cases.title: Aktif kabin yokken tren yönünün son aktif kabine göre belirlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Trenin iki kabini vardır. Önce Kabin A aktifken çalışıyordu, ardından Kabin B aktif oldu. Şu an hiçbir kabin aktif değil (pasif durum).
test_cases.test_inputs: Tüm kabinler pasif.

steps.action: Tren yönü (orientation) parametresi sorgulanır.
steps.expected: Tren yönü, son olarak aktif olan Kabin B'nin tarafına göre tanımlanmış olmalıdır.

test_cases.title: Konum tabanlı bilgi denetiminde tahmini ön ucun kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: Tren konumu geçerlidir. Tahmini ön uç (estimated front end) konumu 1000m, Maksimum güvenli ön uç (max safe front end) konumu 1050m'dir. Konum tabanlı bir bilgi (örneğin bir sinyal konumu) 1020m'de tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Konum tabanlı bilgi denetimi tetikleyicisi.
test_cases.assumptions: Denetlenen bilgi için SUBSET-026'da özel bir referans (örneğin max safe front end) belirtilmemiştir.

steps.action: OBU'nun konum tabanlı bilgiyi denetlemesi sağlanır.
steps.expected: OBU, denetim için 1000m olan tahmini ön uç konumunu referans almalıdır. 1050m olan max safe front end kullanılmamalıdır.

test_cases.title: End Section timer başlangıç konumunda max safe front end referansının kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: Tren konumu geçerlidir. Tahmini ön uç (estimated front end) konumu 1000m, Maksimum güvenli ön uç (max safe front end) konumu 1050m'dir. End Section timer başlangıç konumu 1020m'de tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: End Section timer denetimi.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.6.1.6'ya göre End Section timer başlangıç konumu için max safe front end referans olarak kullanılır.

steps.action: OBU'nun End Section timer başlangıç konumunu denetlemesi sağlanır.
steps.expected: OBU, denetim için 1050m olan max safe front end konumunu referans almalıdır. 1000m olan tahmini ön uç kullanılmamalıdır.

test_cases.title: LRBG uyumlu balise grubu geçildikten sonra konum raporlaması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim halindedir. Bağlantı tutarlılığı kontrolü etkinleştirilmiştir. Önceki mesajlarda bağlantı bilgisi alınmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bağlantılı (linked) ve bağlantı bilgisinde ilan edilmiş bir balise grubu (LRBG uyumlu).
test_cases.assumptions: Balise grubu, SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.8 koşullarını karşılamaktadır.

steps.action: Tren, bağlantılı ve bağlantı bilgisinde ilan edilmiş bir balise grubunu geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, bu balise grubunu LRBGONB olarak belirler.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği konum raporlaması incelenir.
steps.expected: Konum, LRBGONB olarak belirlenen balise grubuna göre referanslandırılmıştır.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı tutarlılığı kontrolü yapılmadığında LRBG uyumlu balise grubu
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim halindedir. Bağlantı tutarlılığı kontrolü devre dışıdır veya yapılmamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bağlantısız (unlinked) olarak işaretlenmemiş bir balise grubu.
test_cases.assumptions: Balise grubu, SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.8 koşullarını karşılamaktadır.

steps.action: Tren, bağlantısız olarak işaretlenmemiş bir balise grubunu geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, bu balise grubunu LRBGONB olarak belirler.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği konum raporlaması incelenir.
steps.expected: Konum, LRBGONB olarak belirlenen balise grubuna göre referanslandırılmıştır.

test_cases.title: LRBG uyumlu olmayan balise grubunun LRBGONB olarak kullanılmaması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim halindedir. Bağlantı tutarlılığı kontrolü etkinleştirilmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bağlantılı olarak işaretlenmemiş veya bağlantı bilgisinde ilan edilmemiş bir balise grubu.
test_cases.assumptions: Balise grubu, SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.8 koşullarını karşılamaktadır ancak LRBG uyumlu değildir.

steps.action: Tren, LRBG uyumlu olmayan bir balise grubunu geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, bu balise grubunu LRBGONB olarak belirlemez.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği konum raporlaması incelenir.
steps.expected: Konum, önceki geçerli LRBGONB'ye göre referanslandırılır veya 'unknown' olarak raporlanır (eğer önceki LRBGONB yoksa).

test_cases.title: Son raporlanan LRBGONB'lerden birine referanslı hat kenarı bilgisinin kabulü
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim halindedir. OBU, son 8 LRBGONB'yi RBC'ye raporlamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen, son raporlanan 8 LRBGONB'den birine referanslı hat kenarı bilgisi.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC, son raporlanan LRBGONB'lerden birini LRBGRBC olarak kullanmaktadır.

steps.action: RBC, son raporlanan 8 LRBGONB'den birine referanslı hat kenarı bilgisi gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, bu bilgiyi kabul eder ve işler.

test_cases.title: Son raporlanan LRBGONB'lerin ötesine referanslı hat kenarı bilgisinin reddi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim halindedir. OBU, son 8 LRBGONB'yi RBC'ye raporlamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen, son raporlanan 8 LRBGONB'nin ötesindeki bir LRBG'ye referanslı hat kenarı bilgisi.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC, son raporlanan 8 LRBGONB'nin ötesindeki bir LRBG'yi LRBGRBC olarak kullanmaktadır.

steps.action: RBC, son raporlanan 8 LRBGONB'nin ötesindeki bir LRBG'ye referanslı hat kenarı bilgisi gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, bu bilgiyi kabul etmez veya hata durumu oluşturur.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores information valid for the opposite direction
test_cases.preconditions: The train is moving in the nominal direction. The OBU is in a state where it processes trackside data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A data packet (e.g., balise message) marked as valid for the 'reverse' direction only.

steps.action: Transmit a data packet to the OBU that is explicitly marked as valid for the reverse direction only.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the data packet. No state change or application of the data occurs.

test_cases.title: OBU accepts information valid for the current train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: The train is moving in the nominal direction. The OBU is in a state where it processes trackside data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A data packet (e.g., balise message) marked as valid for the 'nominal' direction.

steps.action: Transmit a data packet to the OBU that is explicitly marked as valid for the nominal direction.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts and processes the data packet according to its content.

test_cases.title: OBU rejects one-direction data when orientation is unknown
test_cases.preconditions: The train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., no coordinate system assigned or orientation unknown).
test_cases.test_inputs: A data packet marked as valid for the 'nominal' direction only.

steps.action: Transmit a data packet to the OBU that is valid for one direction only (nominal) while the train orientation is unknown relative to the trackside device.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data packet.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates two-direction data when orientation is unknown
test_cases.preconditions: The train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., no coordinate system assigned or orientation unknown).
test_cases.test_inputs: A data packet marked as valid for 'both' directions.

steps.action: Transmit a data packet to the OBU that is valid for both directions while the train orientation is unknown relative to the trackside device.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates and accepts the data packet.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data: Value validity over incremental distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received profile data. Train is moving in the valid direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile data structure with Value(1) and Distance(2).
test_cases.assumptions: Distance values are unsigned increments.

steps.action: Transmit continuous profile data where Value(1) is defined and Distance(2) is a non-zero value D.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value(1) for the distance interval corresponding to Distance(2) (i.e., from the current position to current position + D).

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data: First distance uses previously received data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received profile data with Value(Prev).
test_cases.test_inputs: A new continuous profile data structure starting with Distance(1) and Value(1).

steps.action: Transmit a new continuous profile data structure. Check the profile value applied for the distance interval corresponding to Distance(1).
steps.expected: The OBU uses the previously received data (Value(Prev)) for the distance interval corresponding to Distance(1), not the new Value(1).

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data: Last value applies without limit
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile data structure where the last value is NOT an 'end of profile' value.

steps.action: Transmit a continuous profile data structure ending with Value(N) which is not a special 'end of profile' value.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value(N) for all distances beyond the last defined incremental distance, without limit.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data: Zero distance value is taken into account
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile data structure where Distance(N+1) is 0.

steps.action: Transmit a continuous profile data structure where the incremental distance following Value(N) is 0.
steps.expected: The OBU still takes Value(N) into account for the profile calculation, despite the zero distance increment.

test_cases.title: Location data: Unsigned incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing location data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location data with multiple values and corresponding unsigned incremental distances.

steps.action: Transmit location data where distances are provided as unsigned incremental values between consecutive values.
steps.expected: The OBU correctly calculates the absolute positions of the values by summing the incremental distances from the reference point.

test_cases.title: Location data: First distance uses previously received data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received location data.
test_cases.test_inputs: New location data structure.

steps.action: Transmit a new location data structure. Check the data applied for the first distance interval.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the previously received location data for the first distance interval.

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile data: Element starts and overlaps
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing non-continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Non-continuous profile data with Element 1 (Length L1) and Element 2 (Start Distance D2 < L1).
test_cases.assumptions: Elements are defined by value(n) and length(n).

steps.action: Transmit non-continuous profile data where the start distance of Element 2 is less than the length of Element 1, causing an overlap.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the data and correctly interprets the start of Element 2 as an unsigned incremental distance from the start of Element 1, allowing the overlap.

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile data: First distance uses previous/default data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received non-continuous profile data or has default values.
test_cases.test_inputs: New non-continuous profile data structure.

steps.action: Transmit a new non-continuous profile data structure. Check the data applied for the first distance interval.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the previously received data or initial default values for the first distance interval.

test_cases.title: Linking information: Distances to balise groups
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information with Distance(1) to BG1 and Distance(2) between BG1 and BG2.

steps.action: Transmit linking information where Distance(1) is the distance to the first announced balise group and Distance(2) is the distance between the first and second announced balise groups.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Distance(1) as the distance to BG1 and Distance(2) as the incremental distance from BG1 to BG2, associating the correct linking data with each group.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking consistency is checked.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information containing location accuracy for Balise Group A. Balise Group A is received.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking information provides a valid location accuracy value (e.g., 10m).

steps.action: Receive linking information that specifies the location accuracy for Balise Group A.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the location accuracy from the linking information for Balise Group A.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group A such that it becomes the LRBG or ORBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the location accuracy previously determined from the linking information for Balise Group A.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from National Value when linking is unavailable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. No linking information has determined the location accuracy for Balise Group B. A National Value for location accuracy is applicable.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise Group B is received and becomes LRBG or ORBG.
test_cases.assumptions: The applicable National Value for location accuracy is 15m.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group B such that it becomes the LRBG or ORBG without prior linking information determining its accuracy.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the applicable National Value (15m) as the location accuracy for Balise Group B.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from Default Value when no National Value applies
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. No linking information has determined the location accuracy for Balise Group C. No National Value is applicable.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise Group C is received and becomes LRBG or ORBG.
test_cases.assumptions: The Default Value for location accuracy is 20m.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group C such that it becomes the LRBG or ORBG without prior linking information and without an applicable National Value.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the Default Value (20m) as the location accuracy for Balise Group C.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated upon further linking information
test_cases.preconditions: The location accuracy of Balise Group D has been determined as 10m via linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information is received specifying a different location accuracy (e.g., 12m) for Balise Group D.

steps.action: Receive new linking information that specifies a different location accuracy for Balise Group D.
steps.expected: The OBU retains the original location accuracy of 10m for Balise Group D and does not update it to 12m.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated when linking is no longer checked
test_cases.preconditions: The location accuracy of Balise Group E has been determined as 10m. Linking consistency checking is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking consistency checking is disabled.

steps.action: Disable linking consistency checking.
steps.expected: The OBU retains the location accuracy of 10m for Balise Group E.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated when new National Values become applicable
test_cases.preconditions: The location accuracy of Balise Group F has been determined as 10m. A new National Value for location accuracy (e.g., 15m) becomes applicable.
test_cases.test_inputs: Configuration change making a new National Value applicable.

steps.action: Apply a configuration change that makes a new National Value for location accuracy applicable.
steps.expected: The OBU retains the previously determined location accuracy of 10m for Balise Group F and does not update it to the new National Value.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval delimitation with standard parameters
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Train is moving. No consist-length-related situations are active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated front end position: 1000m. Location accuracy of reference BG: 10m. Over-reading amount: 5m. Under-reading amount: 5m.
test_cases.assumptions: The over-reading and under-reading amounts are derived from odometer accuracy and balise detection errors as per SUBSET-026.

steps.action: Set the estimated front end position to 1000m, location accuracy to 10m, over-reading to 5m, and under-reading to 5m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the min safe front end as 1000m - 10m - 5m = 985m and the max safe front end as 1000m + 10m + 5m = 1015m.

steps.action: Verify the confidence interval boundaries.
steps.expected: The min safe front end is in rear of the estimated front end, and the max safe front end is in advance of the estimated front end.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval delimitation with consist length uncertainty
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A consist-length-related situation defined in SUBSET-026 §3.6.4.1.5 is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated front end position: 1000m. Location accuracy: 10m. Over-reading: 5m. Under-reading: 5m. Consist length uncertainty: 2m.
test_cases.assumptions: The consist length uncertainty is added to both min and max calculations as per the specific situation.

steps.action: Set the parameters including a consist length uncertainty of 2m in a situation where it applies.
steps.expected: The OBU includes the consist length uncertainty in the calculation of the min and max safe front end positions.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection with linking consistency checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. Balise Group G1 is received. Balise Group G2 is received later and is announced in linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence of balise group receptions: G1, then G2 (announced in linking info).

steps.action: Receive Balise Group G1.
steps.expected: G1 becomes the SOLR.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group G2, which is announced in linking information.
steps.expected: G2 becomes the new SOLR because it is the most recently received balise group that is announced in linking information.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection with linking consistency not checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is not checked. Balise Group H1 is received. Balise Group H2 is received later.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence of balise group receptions: H1, then H2.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group H1.
steps.expected: H1 becomes the SOLR.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group H2.
steps.expected: H2 becomes the new SOLR because it is the last received balise group.

test_cases.title: Linking replacement rule applied before SOLR update
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking information is received that affects the SOLR.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information that triggers a change in SOLR.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking replacement rule is defined in SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1 m).

steps.action: Receive linking information that would change the SOLR.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the linking replacement rule before updating the SOLR.

test_cases.title: Relocation before replacement rule for non-linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Location based information referred to a balise group other than the SOLR is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location based information (e.g., a speed restriction) referred to Balise Group I1, while SOLR is Balise Group I2.

steps.action: Receive location based information referred to Balise Group I1.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the information to the SOLR (Balise Group I2) before applying the corresponding replacement rule.

test_cases.title: Processing location based information into min, estimated, max items
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location based information that requires processing into min, estimated, and max location items.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 Table 2a associates specific clauses with location item types for this information.

steps.action: Receive location based information that is processed into up to three location items.
steps.expected: The OBU creates 'min', 'estimated', and 'max' location items for the information.

steps.action: Evaluate the information using the clauses associated with each location item type in SUBSET-026 Table 2a.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items to SOLR using linking information

steps.action: Evaluate location based information referred to Balise Group J2 while J1 is the SOLR.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the location item to the SOLR by subtracting the distance between J2 and J1 (50m) from the distance to J2 (100m), resulting in a new distance of 50m from J1.

test_cases.title: Relocation of min location item with location accuracy adjustment
test_cases.preconditions: Balise Group K1 is the SOLR. Location based information is referred to Balise Group K2. The last relocation was performed as per clause 3.6.4.2.5 c) towards a BG not received earlier than the reference BG. Linking information is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Distance from K2 to min location item: 100m. Distance between K2 and K1 from linking info: 50m. Location accuracy of K2: 10m.

steps.action: Evaluate the min location item referred to Balise Group K2 while K1 is the SOLR.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the min location item by subtracting the distance between K2 and K1 (50m) and twice the location accuracy of K2 (20m) from the distance to K2 (100m), resulting in a new distance of 30m from K1.

test_cases.title: Relocation using travelled distance when linking is not available
test_cases.preconditions: Balise Group L1 is the SOLR. Location based information is referred to Balise Group L2. Linking information is not available or known.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated front end position against L2: 100m. Estimated front end position against L1: 50m.

steps.expected: The OBU relocates the estimated location item by subtracting the estimated travelled distance between L2 and L1 (100m - 50m = 50m) from the distance to L2 (100m), resulting in a new distance of 50m from L1.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation includes distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has received and stored valid geographical position information from a reference balise group. The train is moving in the direction of the track kilometre counting direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement data (odometer/speed) indicating a specific distance travelled from the reference point.

steps.action: Record the initial geographical position displayed or calculated by the OBU immediately after passing the reference balise group (distance travelled = 0).
steps.expected: The displayed/calculated position corresponds to the track kilometre reference value adjusted by the offset.

steps.action: Move the train a known distance (e.g., 100 meters) from the reference location.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the new geographical position by adding the 100 meters travelled to the previous position reference.

steps.action: Request the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The displayed track kilometre value reflects the initial reference value plus the 100 meters travelled, confirming that the distance travelled since the geographical reference location is taken into account.

test_cases.title: Roll-away distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where Roll Away Protection supervision can be started (e.g., Standstill). The train is stationary at a known location not associated with a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: National/Default Value for Roll Away Protection distance (e.g., 10 m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface or log to observe the calculated remaining distance and the supervision status.

steps.action: Trigger the start of Roll Away Protection supervision.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled as the full National/Default Value (e.g., 10 m) minus the estimated distance travelled (0 m at start). The remaining distance is 10 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 2 m (simulated via odometer input).
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 8 m (10 m - 2 m).

steps.action: Enter Staff Responsible mode with the National Value distance.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 10 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 90 m (100 m - 10 m).

test_cases.title: Supervision uses estimated distance from start location
test_cases.preconditions: Roll Away Protection supervision is active. The train has moved 5 m from the start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer data indicating 5 m movement.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs the 'estimated distance travelled away from the location when supervision was started'.

steps.action: Check the internal state of the OBU regarding the distance calculation basis.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the estimated distance travelled (5 m) from the start location to calculate the remaining distance, not the absolute train position relative to balises.

test_cases.title: Virtual train front position with odometer under-reading
test_cases.preconditions: Staff Responsible mode is active with a supervised distance of 100 m. The train has moved 10 m. The odometer has an under-reading of 2 m (meaning the actual distance travelled is 12 m, but odometer reports 10 m, or the correction logic adds the under-reading to the travelled distance for safety). *Assumption: Under-reading means the odometer reports less than actual, so the 'max safe' position must account for the potential extra distance. Formula: Remaining = Supervised - Travelled - Under-reading.*
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised distance: 100 m. Odometer reported travel: 10 m. Odometer under-reading amount: 2 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU diagnostic interface exposes the 'max safe front end position' remaining distance.

steps.action: Move the train such that the odometer reports 10 m travel, with a known under-reading of 2 m.
steps.expected: The remaining distance from the max safe front end position is calculated as 100 m - 10 m - 2 m = 88 m.

test_cases.title: Virtual train front position with odometer over-reading
test_cases.preconditions: Staff Responsible mode is active with a supervised distance of 100 m. The train has moved 10 m. The odometer has an over-reading of 2 m (meaning the odometer reports more than actual). *Assumption: Over-reading means the odometer reports more than actual, so the 'min safe' position is less conservative. Formula: Remaining = Supervised - Travelled + Over-reading.*
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised distance: 100 m. Odometer reported travel: 10 m. Odometer over-reading amount: 2 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU diagnostic interface exposes the 'min safe front end position' remaining distance.

steps.action: Move the train such that the odometer reports 10 m travel, with a known over-reading of 2 m.
steps.expected: The remaining distance from the min safe front end position is calculated as 100 m - 10 m + 2 m = 92 m.

steps.action: Move the train by 1 m.
steps.expected: The OBU detects movement beyond the zero distance and triggers the appropriate safety reaction (e.g., trip condition or de-activation of override).

test_cases.title: Supervision restart resets distance calculation

test_cases.title: MA kısaltma isteğinin kabulü (Sınır durumu: Tren sınırı üzerinde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA'ya sahiptir. RBC ile iletişim kurulmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA kısaltma isteği: Önerilen kısaltılmış MA'nın İndication supervision limit'i, trenin ön ucunun mevcut konumuyla tam olarak aynı noktada olacak şekilde ayarlanır.
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin ön ucunun konumu, önerilen yeni İndication supervision limit'i ile aynıdır. 'In rear' (geride) ifadesi, sınır noktasının dahil edilmediği veya edildiği konusunda spesifik bir tanım vermediğinden, standart ERTMS mantığında sınır noktası genellikle 'geride veya eşit' olarak kabul edilir veya spesifik bir tolerans uygulanır. Bu test, sınır davranışını doğrulamak içindir. Varsayım: Sınır noktası 'in rear' koşulunu sağlar (kabul edilir).

steps.action: RBC'den, trenin ön ucunun önerilen İndication supervision limit'i ile aynı konumda olduğu bir MA kısaltma isteği gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU isteği kabul eder (veya spesifik bir tolerans varsa buna göre davranır). OBU, önerilen kısaltılmış MA'yı yeni geçerli MA olarak kabul eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği yanıt mesajı gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye isteğin kabul edildiğini bildiren bir onay mesajı gönderir.

steps.expected: OBU, duyuru balise grubundan önceki balise grubundan aldığı MA ve hız profiline göre çalışmaya devam eder. Yeni bir MA güncellemesi veya infill verisi işlenmez.

test_cases.title: OBU reads next main signal balise group and ignores subsequent loop infill
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 operation. The OBU has received infill information from a loop for the current main signal. The next main signal balise group is physically present on the track ahead.
test_cases.test_inputs: Loop infill data for the current signal. Balise data for the next main signal.
test_cases.assumptions: The loop infill unit continues to transmit data after the OBU passes the balise to simulate 'further infill information'.

steps.action: Simulate the OBU reading the next main signal balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the balise data and updates its internal state to reflect the new main signal.

steps.action: Transmit new infill information from the loop to the OBU after the balise read event.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the received loop infill information. The internal state related to infill data does not change based on this new input.

test_cases.title: OBU detects missed next main signal balise group and ignores subsequent loop infill
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 operation. The OBU has received infill information from a loop for the current main signal. The next main signal balise group is not present or is unreadable (simulated miss).
test_cases.test_inputs: Loop infill data for the current signal. No valid balise data for the next main signal.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a mechanism to detect that the expected balise group was missed (e.g., based on distance/time or lack of signal).

steps.action: Simulate the OBU detecting that the next main signal balise group was missed.
steps.expected: The OBU registers the miss event and updates its internal state accordingly.

steps.action: Transmit new infill information from the loop to the OBU after the miss detection event.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the received loop infill information. The internal state related to infill data does not change based on this new input.

test_cases.title: Emergency message acknowledgement with correct ID

steps.expected: The OBU receives the message.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's response to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message (Message 147) containing NID_EM = 100.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's response to the RBC.

steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message (Message 147) containing NID_EM = 301.

test_cases.title: Emergency stop aktifken yeni hareket yetkisinin reddedilmesi
