test_cases.title: Multiple authenticators disabled upon reaching failure threshold
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with both password and a second factor (e.g., OTP) enabled. The failure threshold is defined in VBP SDD §14 (assumed to be 5 for this test).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, incorrect password, incorrect second factor code.
test_cases.assumptions: The threshold for consecutive failed attempts is 5, as per VBP SDD §14. The system tracks failures per authenticator and per account.

steps.action: Attempt login with correct username, incorrect password, and correct second factor.
steps.expected: Authentication fails. Password failure count increments to 1.

steps.action: Attempt login with correct username, correct password, and incorrect second factor.
steps.expected: Authentication fails. Second factor failure count increments to 1.

steps.action: Repeat failed attempts alternating between incorrect password and incorrect second factor until the total consecutive failed attempts for the account reach the threshold (5).
steps.expected: The system detects that the threshold has been reached and that more than one authenticator (password and second factor) is involved in the failures.

steps.action: Check the status of the password authenticator for the account.
steps.expected: The password authenticator is disabled.

steps.action: Check the status of the second factor authenticator for the account.
steps.expected: The second factor authenticator is disabled.

test_cases.title: Single authenticator failure does not disable other authenticators
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with both password and a second factor enabled. The failure threshold is 5.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, incorrect password, correct second factor.
test_cases.assumptions: The threshold for consecutive failed attempts is 5. The system only disables all involved authenticators if more than one is involved in the failures reaching the threshold.

steps.action: Attempt login 5 times with correct username, incorrect password, and correct second factor.
steps.expected: All 5 attempts fail. The password failure count reaches the threshold.

steps.action: Check the status of the password authenticator.
steps.expected: The password authenticator is disabled due to reaching the threshold.

steps.action: Check the status of the second factor authenticator.
steps.expected: The second factor authenticator remains enabled, as it was not involved in the failed attempts that reached the threshold.

test_cases.title: Below threshold failures do not disable authenticators
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with both password and a second factor enabled. The failure threshold is 5.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid username, incorrect password, incorrect second factor.
test_cases.assumptions: The threshold for consecutive failed attempts is 5.

steps.action: Attempt login 4 times with correct username, incorrect password, and incorrect second factor.
steps.expected: All 4 attempts fail. The total consecutive failed attempts is 4, which is below the threshold of 5.

steps.action: Check the status of the password authenticator.
steps.expected: The password authenticator remains enabled.

steps.action: Check the status of the second factor authenticator.
steps.expected: The second factor authenticator remains enabled.

test_cases.title: Disabled authenticator requires re-binding before use
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. An authenticator is bound to the account. The failed-attempt threshold defined in VBP SDD §14 is known (assumed to be 5 for this test).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the company representative account. The disabled authenticator.
test_cases.assumptions: The failed-attempt threshold is 5 consecutive failures. The re-binding process is accessible via the portal UI.

steps.action: Attempt authentication 5 times with the bound authenticator using incorrect secrets to trigger the disabled state.
steps.expected: After the 5th failed attempt, the system disables the authenticator and notifies the user that the authenticator has been disabled due to exceeding the failed-attempt threshold.

steps.action: Attempt to use the disabled authenticator for authentication without re-binding.
steps.expected: The system rejects the authentication attempt and indicates that the authenticator is disabled and must be re-bound.

steps.action: Initiate the re-binding process for the disabled authenticator to the company representative account as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.
steps.expected: The system allows the re-binding process to start. Upon successful completion, the authenticator is re-bound to the account and its status changes to active.

steps.action: Attempt authentication using the re-bound authenticator with a correct secret.
steps.expected: The system accepts the authentication and grants access, confirming the authenticator is usable again.

test_cases.title: Re-binding is mandatory even if the authenticator secret is correct
test_cases.preconditions: An authenticator is bound to a company representative account and has been disabled due to reaching the failed-attempt threshold.
test_cases.test_inputs: The correct secret for the disabled authenticator.
test_cases.assumptions: The authenticator is in a disabled state. The user knows the correct secret.

steps.action: Attempt authentication using the disabled authenticator with the correct secret, without performing re-binding.
steps.expected: The system rejects the authentication attempt. The error message should indicate that the authenticator is disabled and requires re-binding, not that the secret is incorrect.

test_cases.title: Re-binding process follows NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1 requirements
test_cases.preconditions: An authenticator is disabled and needs re-binding. The user is authenticated to the company representative account.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid re-binding credentials and authenticator details.
test_cases.assumptions: The re-binding process requires verification of the user's identity and the authenticator's ownership as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.

steps.action: Initiate the re-binding process for the disabled authenticator.
steps.expected: The system prompts for verification steps required by NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1 (e.g., proof of ownership, identity verification).

steps.action: Complete the verification steps successfully.
steps.expected: The system completes the re-binding process and updates the authenticator's status to active.

steps.action: Verify the authenticator's status in the account management section.
steps.expected: The authenticator is listed as active and bound to the company representative account.

test_cases.title: AAL2 gereksinimini karşılamayan e-Devlet yanıtında sınırlı kip açılması
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet federasyonu için AAL2 seviyesini zorunlu kılmaktadır. Test ortamında e-Devlet IdP'si, AAL1 seviyesinde bir kimlik belirteci üretebilmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: AAL1 seviyesinde imzalanmış, geçerli bir e-Devlet kimlik belirteci (token).
test_cases.assumptions: VBP'nin 'sınırlı kip' arayüzü, kişisel veri ve başvuru içeriğinin gizlendiğini ve yeniden giriş önerisi gösterdiğini doğrulamak için tasarlanmıştır.

steps.action: VBP'ye e-Devlet üzerinden giriş yapılır ve AAL1 seviyesinde bir kimlik belirteci iletilir.
steps.expected: VBP, belirtecin AAL2 gereksinimini karşılamadığını algılar ve isteği reddetmez; bunun yerine oturumu 'sınırlı kip'te başlatır.

steps.action: Sınırlı kipte kullanıcı arayüzü incelenir.
steps.expected: Kişisel veri ve başvuru içeriği ekranlarda görünmez. Kullanıcıya daha güçlü bir doğrulama yöntemiyle yeniden giriş yapması önerilir.

test_cases.title: Gerekli IAL/AAL/FAL değerlerini karşılamayan yanıtta istek reddi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, belirli bir işlev için minimum IAL2 ve AAL2 gerektirmektedir. Test ortamında IdP, bu değerlerin altında (örneğin IAL1) bir yanıt üretebilmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: IAL1 ve AAL1 seviyelerinde imzalanmış, VBP'nin minimum gereksinimlerini karşılamayan bir kimlik belirteci.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP, kritik işlevler için minimum xAL değerlerini karşılamayan istekleri doğrudan reddetme mekanizmasına sahiptir.

steps.action: VBP'ye, minimum IAL/AAL gereksinimlerini karşılamayan (IAL1/AAL1) bir e-Devlet yanıtı iletilir.
steps.expected: VBP, isteği reddeder ve kullanıcıya hata mesajı gösterir veya istisna işleme sürecine yönlendirir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, reddedilen istek sonrası korumalı kaynağa erişim denemesi yapar.
steps.expected: Erişim engellenir; kullanıcı, tanımlı mekanizma gereği istisna işleme veya yeniden doğrulama akışuna yönlendirilir.

test_cases.title: Gerekli xAL değerlerini karşılayan yanıtta normal erişim
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet federasyonu için AAL2 ve IAL1 (veya üzeri) gerektirmektedir. Test ortamında IdP, bu değerleri karşılayan bir yanıt üretebilmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: AAL2 ve IAL1 (veya üzeri) seviyelerinde imzalanmış, geçerli bir e-Devlet kimlik belirteci.

steps.action: VBP'ye, VBP'nin gerektirdiği minimum IAL, AAL ve FAL değerlerini karşılayan bir e-Devlet yanıtı iletilir.
steps.expected: VBP, yanıtı kabul eder ve isteği reddetmez veya istisna işleme sürecine yönlendirmez.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, korumalı kaynağa erişim denemesi yapar.
steps.expected: Erişim izlenir ve kullanıcı, tam yetkili modda (sınırlı kip değil) hizmetlerden yararlanır.

test_cases.title: Session AAL must not exceed authentication event AAL
test_cases.preconditions: A user account exists with authentication capabilities for AAL1 and AAL2. The system allows configuring or simulating the AAL of the authentication event.
test_cases.test_inputs: User credentials for AAL1 authentication. A request to access a resource requiring AAL2.
test_cases.assumptions: The system logs or exposes the current session AAL for verification purposes.

steps.action: Authenticate the user using an AAL1 method (e.g., password only).
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds. The session is established with AAL1.

steps.action: Attempt to access a resource or function that requires AAL2 without re-authenticating.
steps.expected: Access is denied. The system does not elevate the session to AAL2. The session remains at AAL1.

test_cases.title: Session AAL can be lower than authentication event AAL
test_cases.preconditions: A user account exists with authentication capabilities for AAL2. The system allows configuring or simulating the AAL of the authentication event.
test_cases.test_inputs: User credentials for AAL2 authentication (e.g., password + OTP).
test_cases.assumptions: The system logs or exposes the current session AAL for verification purposes.

steps.action: Authenticate the user using an AAL2 method.
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds.

steps.action: Access a resource that requires only AAL1.
steps.expected: Access is granted. The session is treated at AAL1 (or lower), which is permitted as it is not higher than the authentication event AAL.

test_cases.title: Authenticated session does not fall back to HTTP
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı portal üzerinde kimlik doğrulamasını başarıyla tamamlamış ve aktif bir HTTPS oturumuna sahiptir.

steps.action: Aktif oturumda iken tarayıcı adres çubuğuna HTTP protokolü ile başlayan bir portal URL'si girilir (örneğin http://portal.kdh.gov.tr).
steps.expected: Sistem, isteği HTTPS protokolüne yönlendirir veya HTTP isteğini reddeder; oturum HTTP üzerinden devam etmez.

steps.action: Yönlendirme sonrası tarayıcının adres çubuğundaki protokol ve oturum durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Adres çubuğunda HTTPS protokolü görünür ve kullanıcı oturumu açık kalır.

test_cases.title: Prevention of session hijacking via insecure transport downgrade
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı portal üzerinde kimlik doğrulamasını başarıyla tamamlamış ve aktif bir HTTPS oturumuna sahiptir.
test_cases.assumptions: Test ortamında istemci tarafında protokol manipülasyonu yapılabilecek bir araç (örneğin proxy veya tarayıcı eklentisi) mevcuttur.

steps.action: Aktif oturum sırasında, istemci tarafında bir araç kullanılarak sonraki isteklerin HTTP protokolü üzerinden gönderilmesi sağlanır.
steps.expected: Sunucu, HTTP üzerinden gelen istekleri reddeder veya otomatik olarak HTTPS'e yönlendirir; oturum bilgileri HTTP üzerinden aktarılmaz.

steps.action: Yönlendirme veya ret işlemi sonrası oturumun durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Oturum güvenli bir kanal (HTTPS) üzerinden devam eder veya güvenli kanal sağlanamıyorsa oturum sonlandırılır.

test_cases.title: Bot detection blocks automated script attempts
test_cases.preconditions: The VBP identity proofing endpoint is accessible. A standard HTTP client capable of sending automated requests is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: A sequence of HTTP requests mimicking a bot (e.g., missing browser headers, rapid consecutive requests, or known bot user-agents) targeting the identity proofing initiation endpoint.
test_cases.assumptions: The system's bot detection mechanism is configured to block or challenge requests identified as automated scripts.

steps.action: Send a series of rapid, automated HTTP requests to the identity proofing initiation endpoint using a script without standard browser headers.
steps.expected: The system detects the automated traffic and blocks the requests or returns a challenge (e.g., CAPTCHA) instead of processing the proofing request.

steps.action: Verify the server logs or security dashboard for the specific IP address used in the previous step.
steps.expected: The logs indicate that the requests were flagged as bot traffic and mitigated according to the configured policy.

test_cases.title: Web Application Firewall blocks malicious payload
test_cases.preconditions: The VBP is protected by a Web Application Firewall (WAF). A valid user session is established.
test_cases.test_inputs: An HTTP request containing a known SQL injection or XSS payload in the input fields of the identity proofing form.
test_cases.assumptions: The WAF is configured to inspect and block common web attack patterns.

steps.action: Submit a form input in the identity proofing process containing a standard SQL injection string (e.g., ' OR 1=1 --).
steps.expected: The WAF intercepts the request and returns a 403 Forbidden or similar error status, preventing the payload from reaching the application backend.

steps.action: Check the WAF logs for the blocked request.
steps.expected: The log entry confirms that the request was blocked due to a detected SQL injection pattern.

test_cases.title: Behavioral analytics flags anomalous user behavior
test_cases.preconditions: Behavioral analytics is enabled for the identity proofing process. A baseline of normal user behavior is established.
test_cases.test_inputs: A user session exhibiting anomalous behavior, such as extremely fast form completion (impossible for a human) or unusual mouse movement patterns.
test_cases.assumptions: The behavioral analytics engine is configured to flag sessions with high risk scores based on speed and interaction patterns.

steps.action: Complete the identity proofing form fields at a speed significantly faster than human capability (e.g., using a macro or script to fill fields instantly).
steps.expected: The system flags the session as high-risk or suspicious due to the anomalous behavioral pattern.

steps.action: Attempt to submit the form.
steps.expected: The submission is blocked, or the user is challenged with additional verification steps (e.g., step-up authentication) due to the high risk score.

test_cases.title: Network traffic analysis identifies high-risk IP
test_cases.preconditions: Network traffic analysis is active. A list of known high-risk or blocklisted IP addresses is maintained.
test_cases.test_inputs: An identity proofing request initiated from an IP address that is on the blocklist or identified as high-risk by the traffic analysis tool.
test_cases.assumptions: The system integrates with a threat intelligence feed or maintains a local blocklist of malicious IPs.

steps.action: Initiate an identity proofing request from a client configured to use a known high-risk or blocklisted IP address.
steps.expected: The system identifies the source IP as high-risk and blocks the request or applies strict mitigation controls.

steps.action: Review the network traffic analysis logs.
steps.expected: The logs show that the request was flagged based on the source IP address matching the high-risk criteria.

test_cases.title: Normal user access is not blocked by security controls
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists. The user is accessing the system from a trusted, non-blocklisted IP address using a standard browser.
test_cases.test_inputs: Standard identity proofing form data entered manually by a human user at a normal pace.
test_cases.assumptions: The security controls (bot detection, WAF, analytics) are tuned to allow legitimate human traffic.

steps.action: Log in with valid credentials and navigate to the identity proofing page.
steps.expected: The page loads successfully without any CAPTCHA challenges or error messages.

steps.action: Fill out the identity proofing form manually with valid data at a normal human speed.
steps.expected: The form accepts the input without triggering any behavioral analytics alerts.

steps.action: Submit the form.
steps.expected: The submission is processed successfully, and the user proceeds to the next step of the proofing process.

test_cases.title: Geçerli TOTP kodunun ilk girişte kabul edilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı TOTP doğrulayıcısına sahiptir ve oturum açma işleminde ikinci faktör aşamasındadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli bir TOTP kodu.

steps.action: Doğrulayıcıda üretilen geçerli TOTP kodu girilir ve onaylanır.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama başarılı olur ve kullanıcı sisteme erişir.

test_cases.title: Aynı TOTP kodunun ikinci kez kullanımının reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı, geçerli bir TOTP kodu ile başarılı bir şekilde kimlik doğrulaması yapmıştır ve oturum sonlandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Daha önce kullanılmış olan TOTP kodu.
test_cases.assumptions: Kodun geçerlilik süresi (30 saniyelik pencere) henüz dolmamıştır.

steps.action: Yeni bir oturum açma denemesinde, daha önce kullanılmış olan TOTP kodu girilir.
steps.expected: Sistem kodu reddeder ve 'kod zaten kullanıldı' veya benzeri bir hata mesajı gösterir.

test_cases.title: Geçerlilik süresi dolan TOTP kodunun reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı ikinci faktör doğrulama aşamasındadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerlilik süresi dolmuş bir TOTP kodu.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, TOTP kodlarının geçerlilik penceresini (mevcut ve bir önceki 30 saniyelik adım) kontrol etmektedir.

steps.action: Geçerlilik süresi dolmuş (örneğin, 2 dakika önce üretilmiş) bir TOTP kodu girilir.
steps.expected: Sistem kodu reddeder ve 'kodun süresi doldu' veya 'geçersiz kod' hatası verir.

test_cases.title: Replacement recovery code issuance triggers notification
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a valid saved recovery code. The account has a valid notification address (e.g., email) configured.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the company representative. Request to replace the current saved recovery code.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is configured to send notifications via the configured channel (e.g., email). The notification content complies with NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.6.

steps.action: Log in as the company representative and request a replacement for the current saved recovery code.
steps.expected: The system generates a new saved recovery code and invalidates the old one.

steps.action: Check the notification channel (e.g., email inbox) associated with the account.
steps.expected: An account recovery notification is received, indicating that a recovery code replacement occurred.

test_cases.title: Notification sent when no other notification address exists
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. The account has no email or phone notification addresses configured, only a postal address.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the company representative. Request to replace the current saved recovery code.
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports postal notification as a fallback when no other addresses are present, per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.6.

steps.action: Log in as the company representative and request a replacement for the current saved recovery code.
steps.expected: The system generates a new saved recovery code.

steps.action: Verify the notification dispatch log or postal service integration.
steps.expected: A notification is queued or sent to the postal address of the account.

test_cases.title: Notification sent when only recovery code address is configured
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. The only notification address configured is the address to which an issued recovery code was previously sent (e.g., a specific email). No other notification addresses exist.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the company representative. Request to replace the current saved recovery code.
test_cases.assumptions: The system identifies the 'recovery code address' and treats it as the sole notification target, requiring postal fallback or specific handling per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.6.

steps.action: Log in as the company representative and request a replacement for the current saved recovery code.
steps.expected: The system generates a new saved recovery code.

steps.action: Verify the notification dispatch mechanism.
steps.expected: A notification is sent to the postal address, as the only other notification address is the recovery code address.

test_cases.title: Saved recovery code invalidation and new code issuance upon successful use
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a valid saved recovery code. The account is in a state where recovery is required (e.g., password reset or MFA reset).
test_cases.test_inputs: The current valid saved recovery code.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows triggering the account recovery flow for testing purposes.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the saved recovery code.

steps.action: Enter the current valid saved recovery code and submit it.
steps.expected: The system accepts the code and completes the recovery process.

steps.action: Check the status of the previously used recovery code in the system backend or user interface.
steps.expected: The previously used recovery code is marked as invalid or deleted.

steps.action: Verify that a new saved recovery code has been issued to the company representative.
steps.expected: A new, unique saved recovery code is displayed or sent to the representative, and it is stored in the account.

test_cases.title: Re-use of an invalidated saved recovery code is rejected
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. A saved recovery code has already been used and invalidated, and a new code has been issued.
test_cases.test_inputs: The previously used (now invalidated) saved recovery code.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the saved recovery code.

steps.action: Enter the previously used (invalidated) saved recovery code and submit it.
steps.expected: The system rejects the code and displays an error message indicating the code is invalid or expired.

steps.action: Verify that no new recovery code is issued and the account state remains unchanged.
steps.expected: The account remains in the recovery-pending state, and the current valid recovery code remains active.

test_cases.title: AAL2 ile hesap erişimi sağlanması
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde AAL2 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulama yapılandırılmış ve test hesabına AAL2 uyumlu bir kimlik doğrulayıcı (authenticator) kayıtlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kayıtlı AAL2 kimlik doğrulayıcısı ve ilgili kimlik bilgileri.
test_cases.assumptions: AAL2, iki farklı kimlik doğrulama faktörünün (ör. şifre + SMS/TOTP) güvenli protokollerle kullanılmasını gerektirir.

steps.action: Vatandaş Başvuru Portalı'na (VBP) şirket temsilcisi hesabıyla giriş yapılır ve AAL2 kimlik doğrulama süreci tamamlanır.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama başarılı olur ve kullanıcı hesabına erişim sağlar.

steps.action: Hesap içindeki kişisel bilgilere erişim denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Kişisel bilgiler başarıyla görüntülenir.

test_cases.title: AAL3 ile hesap erişimi sağlanması
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde AAL3 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulama yapılandırılmış ve test hesabına AAL3 uyumlu bir kimlik doğrulayıcı (ör. FIDO2/WebAuthn) kayıtlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kayıtlı AAL3 kimlik doğrulayıcısı ve ilgili kimlik bilgileri.
test_cases.assumptions: AAL3, kamuya açık anahtar kriptografisi kullanan ve phishing'e dayanıklı bir kimlik doğrulayıcı gerektirir.

steps.action: Vatandaş Başvuru Portalı'na (VBP) şirket temsilcisi hesabıyla giriş yapılır ve AAL3 kimlik doğrulama süreci tamamlanır.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama başarılı olur ve kullanıcı hesabına erişim sağlar.

steps.action: Hesap içindeki kişisel bilgilere erişim denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Kişisel bilgiler başarıyla görüntülenir.

test_cases.title: AAL1 ile hesap erişiminin reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde AAL1 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulama yapılandırılmıştır ancak şirket temsilcisi hesabı için AAL2 veya AAL3 zorunludur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sadece AAL1 uyumlu kimlik doğrulama bilgileri (ör. sadece şifre).
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, şirket temsilcisi hesapları için AAL2 veya AAL3 altındaki giriş denemelerini reddetmelidir.

steps.action: Vatandaş Başvuru Portalı'na (VBP) şirket temsilcisi hesabıyla sadece AAL1 seviyesinde kimlik doğrulama bilgileri girilerek giriş denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Giriş reddedilir ve kullanıcıya AAL2 veya AAL3 kimlik doğrulaması gerektiğine dair bir hata mesajı gösterilir.

steps.action: Hesap içindeki kişisel bilgilere erişim denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Erişim sağlanamaz, oturum açılmaz.

test_cases.title: Kayıtlı olmayan kimlik doğrulayıcıyla erişimin reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Test hesabına AAL2 uyumlu bir kimlik doğrulayıcı kayıtlıdır ancak farklı bir AAL2 uyumlu kimlik doğrulayıcı kullanılmaya çalışılacaktır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Hesaba kayıtlı olmayan AAL2 uyumlu bir kimlik doğrulayıcı.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, yalnızca hesaba kayıtlı kimlik doğrulayıcıları kabul etmelidir.

steps.action: Vatandaş Başvuru Portalı'na (VBP) şirket temsilcisi hesabıyla giriş yapılır ve hesaba kayıtlı olmayan AAL2 uyumlu bir kimlik doğrulayıcı kullanılır.
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama başarısız olur ve kullanıcıya kayıtlı olmayan bir kimlik doğrulayıcı kullanıldığına dair bir hata mesajı gösterilir.

steps.action: Hesap içindeki kişisel bilgilere erişim denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Erişim sağlanamaz, oturum açılmaz.

test_cases.title: Representative account information update notification
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists and is active. The representative has a valid notification channel (e.g., email) configured.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid update request for a non-core attribute (e.g., phone number) in the representative account.
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports updating non-core attributes directly by the subscriber as per NIST SP 800-63A-4 §5.3.

steps.action: Log in as the company representative and request an update to a non-core attribute in their account.
steps.expected: The system accepts the update request and processes the change.

steps.action: Check the representative's notification channel (e.g., email inbox).
steps.expected: A notification is received informing the representative that an update was made to their account information.

test_cases.title: Notification content verification for account update
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. A notification has been triggered by a recent account update.
test_cases.test_inputs: The notification message generated by the system.
test_cases.assumptions: The notification mechanism is functional and delivers messages to the configured channel.

steps.action: Retrieve the notification message sent to the representative following an account update.
steps.expected: The message is present in the notification channel.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the notification message.
steps.expected: The message explicitly states that an update was made to the representative's account information, as required by NIST SP 800-63A-4 §5.3.

test_cases.title: Company representative reports unauthorized access
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists and is authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: A report description indicating unauthorized access.
test_cases.assumptions: The system provides a specific UI element or form field for reporting security incidents.

steps.action: Log in as a company representative.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated and redirected to the account dashboard.

steps.action: Navigate to the account security or support section and select the option to report unauthorized access or potential compromise.
steps.expected: A form or interface for submitting the security report is displayed.

steps.action: Enter a description of the suspected unauthorized access and submit the report.
steps.expected: The system accepts the report and displays a confirmation message indicating the report has been received.

test_cases.title: Company representative reports potential compromise
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists and is authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: A report description indicating potential data compromise.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows reporting of 'potential compromise' as a distinct or combined category with unauthorized access.

steps.action: Log in as a company representative.
steps.expected: The user is successfully authenticated.

steps.action: Access the security reporting feature and select the option for 'potential compromise'.
steps.expected: The system presents the appropriate input fields for detailing the potential compromise.

steps.action: Submit the report with details about the potential compromise.
steps.expected: The system processes the report and confirms receipt to the user.

test_cases.title: Unauthenticated user cannot report unauthorized access
test_cases.preconditions: The user is not logged in.
test_cases.test_inputs: N/A
test_cases.assumptions: The reporting feature is only accessible within an authenticated session.

steps.action: Attempt to access the URL or interface for reporting unauthorized access without logging in.
steps.expected: The system denies access and redirects the user to the login page or displays an authentication error.

test_cases.title: Beklenmeyen hata durumunda genel mesaj gösterimi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde beklenmeyen bir hatanın tetiklenebileceği bir test ortamı veya hata enjeksiyon mekanizması mevcuttur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Beklenmeyen bir istisna tetikleyecek girdi veya senaryo.
test_cases.assumptions: Hata enjeksiyonu veya test ortamı, üretim verilerini etkilemeden beklenmeyen bir istisna oluşturmayı sağlar.

steps.action: Beklenmeyen veya güvenlikle ilgili bir hatanın tetiklenmesine neden olacak bir işlem yapılır.
steps.expected: Sistem hata durumuna geçer.

steps.action: Kullanıcıya dönen yanıt mesajı incelenir.
steps.expected: Mesaj genel bir hata bildirimi içerir; yığın izi (stack trace), veritabanı sorgusu, gizli anahtar veya token gibi iç detaylar bulunmaz.

steps.action: Mesajda bir ilişki kimliği (correlation ID) olup olmadığı kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Mesajda kullanıcıya destek amaçlı bir ilişki kimliği gösterilir.

test_cases.title: Güvenlik hassasiyetli hata durumunda detay sızdırılmaması
test_cases.preconditions: Yetkilendirme veya kimlik doğrulama mekanizmalarında hata üretebilecek bir test senaryosu hazırlanmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçersiz veya manipüle edilmiş yetki bilgisi içeren istek.

steps.action: Güvenlik açısından hassas bir hata durumunu tetikleyecek şekilde yetkilendirme hatası içeren bir istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: İstek reddedilir.

steps.action: Dönen hata mesajının içeriği analiz edilir.
steps.expected: Mesaj genel bir hata bildirimi şeklindedir; sistem içi yapı, sürüm bilgisi, sorgu detayı veya hassas token bilgisi içermez.

test_cases.title: Session cookie has HttpOnly attribute and is set via Set-Cookie header
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists. The user is not logged in.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the test account.
test_cases.assumptions: The session cookie name is known or can be identified from the response headers.

steps.action: Log in to the portal with valid credentials.
steps.expected: The login is successful and the user is redirected to the dashboard.

steps.action: Inspect the HTTP response headers of the login request to find the 'Set-Cookie' header for the session cookie.
steps.expected: The 'Set-Cookie' header is present and contains the session token value.

steps.action: Check the attributes of the session cookie in the 'Set-Cookie' header.
steps.expected: The 'HttpOnly' attribute is present in the cookie definition.

steps.action: Execute a JavaScript snippet in the browser console to attempt to read the session cookie using 'document.cookie'.
steps.expected: The session cookie is not visible in the 'document.cookie' string.

test_cases.title: Non-session cookies not meant for client-side access have HttpOnly attribute
test_cases.preconditions: The portal sets at least one additional cookie (e.g., for CSRF token or preference) that is not intended to be read by client-side scripts.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for the test account.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific non-session cookie name is identified from the application design or response headers.

steps.action: Log in to the portal with valid credentials.
steps.expected: The login is successful.

steps.action: Inspect the 'Set-Cookie' headers in the response to identify cookies other than the session cookie.
steps.expected: At least one non-session cookie is present in the response.

steps.action: Check the attributes of the identified non-session cookie.
steps.expected: The 'HttpOnly' attribute is present for cookies not meant to be accessible to client-side scripts.

test_cases.title: HSTS header present on all responses with correct configuration
test_cases.preconditions: The VBP Software Design Document §14 specifies the maximum age and subdomain coverage for HSTS.
test_cases.test_inputs: URLs for various portal pages (e.g., login page, dashboard, static asset).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific max-age and includeSubDomains values are defined in VBP SDD §14.

steps.action: Send an HTTPS request to the portal's main page.
steps.expected: The response includes a 'Strict-Transport-Security' header.

steps.action: Verify the 'max-age' value in the HSTS header.
steps.expected: The 'max-age' value matches the value defined in VBP SDD §14.

steps.action: Verify the 'includeSubDomains' directive in the HSTS header.
steps.expected: The 'includeSubDomains' directive is present if required by VBP SDD §14.

steps.action: Send an HTTPS request to a different portal page (e.g., a static resource or API endpoint).
steps.expected: The response also includes the 'Strict-Transport-Security' header with the same configuration.

test_cases.title: Valid file extension and content match
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated and has permission to upload files.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid PDF file with .pdf extension and correct PDF magic bytes.

steps.action: Upload a valid PDF file with a .pdf extension.
steps.expected: The system accepts the file and confirms the upload successfully.

test_cases.title: File extension mismatch with content
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated and has permission to upload files.
test_cases.test_inputs: A file with .jpg extension but containing PDF content (magic bytes indicate PDF).

steps.action: Upload a file with .jpg extension that contains PDF content.
steps.expected: The system rejects the file and displays an error message indicating a mismatch between file extension and content.

test_cases.title: Unsupported file extension
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated and has permission to upload files.
test_cases.test_inputs: A file with .exe extension.
test_cases.assumptions: The system does not allow .exe files as per VBP Software Design Document.

steps.action: Upload a file with .exe extension.
steps.expected: The system rejects the file and displays an error message indicating that the file type is not allowed.

test_cases.title: Image within maximum pixel size
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated and has permission to upload images.
test_cases.test_inputs: An image with pixel dimensions below the maximum defined in VBP Software Design Document §14.
test_cases.assumptions: The maximum pixel size is defined in VBP Software Design Document §14.

steps.action: Upload an image with pixel dimensions below the maximum allowed size.
steps.expected: The system accepts the image and confirms the upload successfully.

test_cases.title: Image exceeding maximum pixel size
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated and has permission to upload images.
test_cases.test_inputs: An image with pixel dimensions exceeding the maximum defined in VBP Software Design Document §14.
test_cases.assumptions: The maximum pixel size is defined in VBP Software Design Document §14.

steps.action: Upload an image with pixel dimensions exceeding the maximum allowed size.
steps.expected: The system rejects the image and displays an error message indicating that the image size exceeds the maximum allowed dimensions.

test_cases.title: Failed sign-in response consistency for existing and non-existing users
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists in the system. A non-existing user identifier is known for testing.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid user identifier, invalid password. Non-existing user identifier, invalid password.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is accessible and network latency is stable enough to measure response times.

steps.action: Attempt sign-in with a valid user identifier and an incorrect password.
steps.expected: The system returns a generic error message (e.g., 'Invalid credentials') and an HTTP status code (e.g., 401 or 200 with error body). The response time is recorded.

steps.action: Attempt sign-in with a non-existing user identifier and an incorrect password.
steps.expected: The system returns the exact same generic error message and HTTP status code as in step 1. The response time is statistically indistinguishable from step 1 (within a small margin of error).

test_cases.title: Registration response consistency for existing and non-existing email addresses
test_cases.preconditions: An email address already registered in the system is known. A new, unregistered email address is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Existing email address, valid registration data. New email address, valid registration data.
test_cases.assumptions: The registration endpoint is accessible.

steps.action: Submit a registration request with an email address that is already registered.
steps.expected: The system returns a generic response (e.g., 'Registration request processed' or a generic error) and an HTTP status code. The response time is recorded.

steps.action: Submit a registration request with a new, unregistered email address.
steps.expected: The system returns the exact same generic response and HTTP status code as in step 1. The response time is statistically indistinguishable from step 1.

test_cases.title: Forgotten password response consistency for existing and non-existing users
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists. A non-existing user identifier is known.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid user identifier. Non-existing user identifier.
test_cases.assumptions: The forgotten password endpoint is accessible.

steps.action: Submit a forgotten password request with a valid user identifier.
steps.expected: The system returns a generic success message (e.g., 'If the account exists, a reset link has been sent') and an HTTP status code. The response time is recorded.

steps.action: Submit a forgotten password request with a non-existing user identifier.
steps.expected: The system returns the exact same generic success message and HTTP status code as in step 1. The response time is statistically indistinguishable from step 1.

test_cases.title: Help Desk initiates password reset without setting password
test_cases.preconditions: A Help Desk staff account with appropriate permissions is available. A company representative account exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Help Desk staff credentials, representative user identifier.
test_cases.assumptions: The Help Desk interface allows initiating a password reset process.

steps.action: Log in as Help Desk staff and initiate the password reset process for the company representative.
steps.expected: The system successfully initiates the reset process (e.g., sends a reset link or token to the representative). The Help Desk interface does not provide a field or option to set or choose a new password for the representative.

steps.action: Verify that the Help Desk staff cannot directly change the representative's password through any other interface or API endpoint.
steps.expected: Any attempt to directly set the password via API or UI is rejected with an authorization error.

test_cases.title: New session token generation and old token invalidation upon re-authentication
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated with a valid session token (Token A).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid credentials for re-authentication.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows re-authentication while a session is active.

steps.action: Capture the current session token (Token A) and its associated backend state.
steps.expected: Token A is valid and active in the backend.

steps.action: Perform re-authentication using valid credentials.
steps.expected: The system generates a new session token (Token B) and returns it to the client.

steps.action: Attempt to use Token A to access a protected resource.
steps.expected: The request is rejected, and the backend indicates that Token A is invalid or terminated.

steps.action: Attempt to use Token B to access a protected resource.
steps.expected: The request is successful, and the resource is returned.

test_cases.title: Session invalidation upon logout
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated with a valid session token.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid session token.

steps.action: Initiate the logout process using the active session token.
steps.expected: The logout is successful, and the session is terminated.

steps.action: Attempt to use the same session token to access a protected resource.
steps.expected: The request is rejected, and the backend indicates that the session is invalid.

test_cases.title: Session invalidation upon expiration
test_cases.preconditions: User is authenticated with a session token that has a defined expiration time.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid session token.
test_cases.assumptions: The session expiration time can be controlled or waited out for testing purposes.

steps.action: Wait for the session to expire or trigger the expiration condition.
steps.expected: The session is marked as expired in the backend.

steps.action: Attempt to use the expired session token to access a protected resource.
steps.expected: The request is rejected, and the backend indicates that the session is invalid or expired.

test_cases.title: Accessing own application data with valid identifier
test_cases.preconditions: User A is authenticated and has explicit permission to view Application X and Document Y.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid session token for User A, valid identifier for Document Y owned by User A.

steps.action: Send a request to retrieve Document Y using its valid identifier.
steps.expected: The system returns the content of Document Y successfully.

test_cases.title: Attempting to access another user's data by changing identifier
test_cases.preconditions: User A is authenticated and has permission to Document Y. User B is authenticated and has permission to Document Z. User A does not have permission to Document Z.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid session token for User A, valid identifier for Document Z owned by User B.

steps.action: Send a request to retrieve Document Z using its valid identifier while authenticated as User A.
steps.expected: The system denies access and returns an authorization error (e.g., 403 Forbidden). The content of Document Z is not exposed.

test_cases.title: Attempting to access non-existent data item
test_cases.preconditions: User A is authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid session token for User A, an identifier that does not correspond to any existing document.

steps.action: Send a request to retrieve a document using a non-existent identifier.
steps.expected: The system returns a 'Not Found' error (e.g., 404) or a generic error message. No data is exposed.

test_cases.title: Bilgi taşıyan görsellerin metin alternatifinin doğrulanması
test_cases.preconditions: Portal açık ve erişilebilirlik denetimi yapılabilecek bir tarayıcı veya ekran okuyucu mevcut.
test_cases.test_inputs: Başvuru formu içeren bir sayfa.

steps.action: Başvuru formundaki bilgi taşıyan bir görselin (örneğin logo veya bilgilendirme ikonu) HTML kaynağındaki alt özniteliği incelenir.
steps.expected: Görselin amacını açıklayan, boş olmayan bir metin alternatifi (alt metni) tanımlıdır.

steps.action: Yardımcı teknoloji (ekran okuyucu) ile aynı görselin üzerine odaklanılır.
steps.expected: Ekran okuyucu, görselin amacını açıklayan metni sesli olarak okur.

test_cases.title: Süsleme amaçlı görsellerin işaretlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Portal açık.
test_cases.test_inputs: Süsleme amaçlı bir arka plan görseli veya dekoratif ikon içeren bir sayfa.

steps.action: Süsleme amaçlı görselin HTML kaynağındaki alt özniteliği incelenir.
steps.expected: Alt özniteliği boş string ('') olarak tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: Yardımcı teknoloji ile süsleme amaçlı görselin üzerine odaklanılır.
steps.expected: Ekran okuyucu bu öğeyi atlar ve sesli geri bildirim vermez.

test_cases.title: Görsel düğmelerin ve denetim öğelerinin adlandırılması
test_cases.preconditions: Portal açık.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yalnızca ikon içeren bir 'Gönder' düğmesi.

steps.action: Yalnızca ikon içeren düğmenin HTML kaynağındaki aria-label veya alt metni incelenir.
steps.expected: Düğmenin amacını açıklayan (örneğin 'Başvuruyu Gönder') bir metin etiketi tanımlıdır.

steps.action: Klavye ile düğmeye odaklanılır ve ekran okuyucu dinlenir.
steps.expected: Ekran okuyucu düğmenin adını ve rolünü (örneğin 'Gönder, düğme') okur.

test_cases.title: Tabloların programlı yapısının doğrulanması
test_cases.preconditions: Portal açık.
test_cases.test_inputs: Başvuru durumlarını gösteren bir tablo içeren sayfa.

steps.action: Tablonun HTML kaynağındaki yapısal etiketler (table, thead, tbody, th, td) incelenir.
steps.expected: Tablo, başlık hücreleri (th) ve veri hücreleri (td) ile doğru semantik yapıda tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: Yardımcı teknoloji ile tablonun bir hücresine odaklanılır.
steps.expected: Ekran okuyucu, hücrenin ait olduğu satır ve sütun başlıklarını bağlam olarak okur.

test_cases.title: Başlıkların hiyerarşik yapısının doğrulanması
test_cases.preconditions: Portal açık.
test_cases.test_inputs: Çok bölümlü bir başvuru sayfası.

steps.action: Sayfanın HTML kaynağındaki başlık etiketleri (h1-h6) incelenir.
steps.expected: Başlıklar hiyerarşik olarak sıralanmıştır (örneğin h1'den sonra h2 gelir, h1'den doğrudan h3'e atlanılmaz).

steps.action: Yardımcı teknoloji ile sayfanın başlık yapısı listelenir.
steps.expected: Başlıklar, sayfanın içeriğini yansıtan doğru hiyerarşide listelenir.

test_cases.title: Dikey ve yatay ekran yönlerinde içerik erişilebilirliği
test_cases.preconditions: Portal açık.
test_cases.test_inputs: Standart bir başvuru formu sayfası.

steps.action: Tarayıcı penceresi dikey (portrait) yönde ayarlanır ve sayfa görüntülenir.
steps.expected: İçerik okunabilir, form alanları erişilebilir ve işlevsellik korunur.

steps.action: Tarayıcı penceresi yatay (landscape) yönde ayarlanır ve sayfa görüntülenir.
steps.expected: İçerik okunabilir, form alanları erişilebilir ve işlevsellik korunur; içerik kaybolmaz veya kullanılamaz hale gelmez.

test_cases.title: Form alanlarının autocomplete özniteliklerinin doğrulanması
test_cases.preconditions: Portal açık.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ad, e-posta ve telefon alanları içeren bir form.

steps.action: Ad alanının HTML kaynağındaki autocomplete özniteliği incelenir.
steps.expected: autocomplete özniteliği 'name' veya 'given-name' gibi uygun bir değerle işaretlenmiştir.

steps.action: E-posta alanının HTML kaynağındaki autocomplete özniteliği incelenir.
steps.expected: autocomplete özniteliği 'email' olarak işaretlenmiştir.

steps.action: Telefon alanının HTML kaynağındaki autocomplete özniteliği incelenir.
steps.expected: autocomplete özniteliği 'tel' olarak işaretlenmiştir.

test_cases.title: Standart metin kontrast oranının doğrulanması
test_cases.preconditions: Portal açık.
test_cases.test_inputs: Standart boyutta (14pt veya 18.66px bold altı) metin içeren bir sayfa.

steps.action: Standart boyuttaki bir metin parçasının metin rengi ve arka plan rengi bir kontrast hesaplama aracıyla ölçülür.
steps.expected: Kontrast oranı en az 4.5:1'dir.

test_cases.title: Büyük boyutlu metin kontrast oranının doğrulanması
test_cases.preconditions: Portal açık.
test_cases.test_inputs: Büyük boyutta (18pt veya 24px bold) metin içeren bir başlık.

steps.action: Büyük boyuttaki başlık metninin metin rengi ve arka plan rengi bir kontrast hesaplama aracıyla ölçülür.
steps.expected: Kontrast oranı en az 3:1'dir.

test_cases.title: Metnin %200 büyütülmesinde içerik kaybı olmaması
test_cases.preconditions: Portal açık.
test_cases.test_inputs: Form ve metin içeren bir sayfa.

steps.action: Tarayıcı zoom seviyesi %200'e ayarlanır.
steps.expected: Metin okunabilir kalır, içerik kesilmez, kaybolmaz ve form işlevselliği bozulmaz.

test_cases.title: Bilgi aktarımında metin kullanımı
test_cases.preconditions: Portal açık.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bilgi içeren bir görsel (örneğin bir diyagram veya infografik) içeren sayfa.

steps.action: Sayfadaki bilgi taşıyan görsellerin metin eşdeğeri olup olmadığı kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Görseldeki bilgi, metin olarak da sunulmuştur veya görsel, metinle aynı bilgiyi aktaracak şekilde tasarlanmıştır; bilgi yalnızca görselde kalmamıştır.

test_cases.title: Satır ve paragraf aralıklarının artırılmasında içerik kaybı olmaması
test_cases.preconditions: Portal açık.
test_cases.test_inputs: Uzun metin paragrafları içeren bir sayfa.
