test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing linking information with multiple balise groups.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information with Distance(2) and Value(2).

steps.action: Transmit linking information where Distance(2) is the distance between the first and second announced balise groups.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Distance(2) as the distance between the first and second announced balise groups.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking consistency is checked.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information containing location accuracy for Balise Group A. Balise Group A is received.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking information provides a valid location accuracy value (e.g., 10m).

steps.action: Receive linking information that specifies the location accuracy for Balise Group A.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the location accuracy from the linking information for Balise Group A.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group A such that it becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the location accuracy previously determined from linking information for Balise Group A.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from National Value when linking is unavailable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking consistency is checked. No linking information has determined the location accuracy for Balise Group B.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise Group B is received. National Value for location accuracy is configured (e.g., 20m).
test_cases.assumptions: The National Value is applicable for the current location.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group B such that it becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the configured National Value as the location accuracy for Balise Group B.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from Default Value when National Value is not applicable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking consistency is checked. No linking information has determined the location accuracy for Balise Group C. No National Value is applicable.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise Group C is received. Default Value for location accuracy is configured (e.g., 30m).
test_cases.assumptions: The Default Value is used when no National Value is applicable.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group C such that it becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the configured Default Value as the location accuracy for Balise Group C.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy is not updated upon further linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined the location accuracy for Balise Group A from linking information (e.g., 10m). Balise Group A is the LRBG.
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information is received that specifies a different location accuracy for Balise Group A (e.g., 15m).

steps.action: Receive new linking information with a different location accuracy for Balise Group A.
steps.expected: The OBU does not update the location accuracy for Balise Group A; it remains 10m.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy is not updated when linking is no longer checked
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined the location accuracy for Balise Group A (e.g., 10m). Linking consistency is currently checked.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking consistency checking is disabled.

steps.action: Disable linking consistency checking.
steps.expected: The location accuracy for Balise Group A remains 10m and is not updated.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy is not updated when new National Values become applicable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined the location accuracy for Balise Group A (e.g., 10m).
test_cases.test_inputs: New National Values are loaded that would specify a different location accuracy for Balise Group A.

steps.action: Load new National Values that specify a different location accuracy for Balise Group A.
steps.expected: The location accuracy for Balise Group A remains 10m and is not updated.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval delimitation with location accuracy and over/under-reading
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Train is moving. Reference balise group (LRBG) has a known location accuracy (e.g., 10m). Over-reading amount is 5m, under-reading amount is 5m. No consist length uncertainty applies.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated front end position is 100m from LRBG.
test_cases.assumptions: Consist length uncertainty is not applicable in this scenario.

steps.action: Calculate the min safe front end position.
steps.expected: The min safe front end position is 100m - 10m (location accuracy) - 5m (under-reading) = 85m from LRBG.

steps.action: Calculate the max safe front end position.
steps.expected: The max safe front end position is 100m + 10m (location accuracy) + 5m (over-reading) = 115m from LRBG.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is checked
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking consistency is checked.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise Group A is received and is the reference of linking information. Balise Group B is received later and is announced in linking information.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group A which is the reference of linking information.
steps.expected: The SOLR is set to Balise Group A.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group B which is announced in linking information.
steps.expected: The SOLR is updated to Balise Group B.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is not checked
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking consistency is not checked.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise Group A is received. Balise Group B is received later.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group A.
steps.expected: The SOLR is set to Balise Group A.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group B.
steps.expected: The SOLR is updated to Balise Group B.

test_cases.title: Linking replacement rule applied before SOLR update
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking consistency is checked. Current SOLR is Balise Group A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information is received that announces Balise Group B as the new reference.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking replacement rule specifies that the new linking information replaces the old one.

steps.action: Receive linking information that announces Balise Group B.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the linking replacement rule, updating the linking information to reference Balise Group B.

steps.action: Update the SOLR based on the new linking information.
steps.expected: The SOLR is updated to Balise Group B.

test_cases.title: Processing location based information into min, estimated, max items
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location based information (e.g., a signal) is received with a distance of 100m from the reference balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The location accuracy is 10m.

steps.action: Process the location based information.
steps.expected: The OBU creates three location items: min (90m), estimated (100m), and max (110m).

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items to SOLR using linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Current SOLR is Balise Group A. A location item is referred to Balise Group B. The distance between Balise Group B and Balise Group A is known from linking information (e.g., 50m).
test_cases.test_inputs: The location item has a distance of 100m from Balise Group B.
test_cases.assumptions: The last relocation of this location item was not performed as per clause 3.6.4.2.5 c).

steps.action: Relocate the location item to the SOLR (Balise Group A).
steps.expected: The new distance of the location item from the SOLR is 100m - 50m = 50m.

test_cases.title: Relocation of min location item with location accuracy adjustment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Current SOLR is Balise Group A. A min location item is referred to Balise Group B. The distance between Balise Group B and Balise Group A is known from linking information (e.g., 50m). The location accuracy of Balise Group B is 10m.
test_cases.test_inputs: The min location item has a distance of 100m from Balise Group B.
test_cases.assumptions: The last relocation of this location item was performed as per clause 3.6.4.2.5 c) towards a BG not received earlier than the reference BG of this location item.

steps.action: Relocate the min location item to the SOLR (Balise Group A).
steps.expected: The new distance of the min location item from the SOLR is 100m - 50m - 2*10m = 30m.

test_cases.title: Position report on reaching standstill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active. The train is moving. Position report parameters are configured such that no periodic report is due at the moment of standstill.

steps.action: Bring the train to a complete standstill.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent position report.
steps.expected: The report reflects the event of reaching standstill (e.g., speed is 0, status indicates standstill).

test_cases.title: Position report on leaving standstill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active. The train is at standstill. A position report for reaching standstill has already been sent.

steps.action: Accelerate the train from standstill to a non-zero speed.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent position report.
steps.expected: The report reflects the event of leaving standstill (e.g., speed > 0).

test_cases.title: Position report on mode change
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a valid operational mode (e.g., Full Supervision). Position reporting is active.

steps.action: Trigger a mode change (e.g., from Full Supervision to Shunting or Standstill).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent position report.
steps.expected: The report reflects the new mode of operation.

test_cases.title: Position report on level change
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2. Position reporting is active.

steps.action: Trigger a level change (e.g., from Level 2 to Level 1 or NTC).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC (if applicable to the new level context) or updates its internal state such that the next relevant report reflects the change. Note: If the level change results in loss of RBC communication, the report might be suppressed or sent to the last known RBC depending on specific implementation details, but the event must be processed. For this test, assume the change is to a level where RBC communication is still possible or the report is sent before loss.

steps.action: Verify the OBU's behavior regarding the level change event.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the level change event as defined in 3.6.5.1.4 g). If a position report is sent, it reflects the level change.

test_cases.title: Position report on session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is not currently in a communication session with an RBC. It is capable of establishing a session.

steps.action: Establish a successful communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC immediately after the session is successfully established.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent position report.
steps.expected: The report reflects the successful session establishment.

test_cases.title: Position report on passing LRBG without stored parameters
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active. No position report parameters are stored on-board. The train is approaching an LRBG compliant balise group.

steps.action: Pass the LRBG compliant balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent position report.
steps.expected: The report reflects the passage of the LRBG compliant balise group.

test_cases.title: Position report on RBC/RBC border crossing (min safe rear end)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active. The train is approaching an RBC/RBC border.

steps.action: Cross the RBC/RBC border such that the minimum safe rear end of the train passes the border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent position report.
steps.expected: The report reflects the crossing of the RBC/RBC border.

test_cases.title: Report train integrity status as 'No integrity information'
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a communication session with an RBC. The train integrity status is 'No integrity information'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the train integrity information in the position report.
steps.expected: The train integrity status is reported as 'No integrity information'. No confirmed train length is included in the report.

test_cases.title: Report train integrity status as 'Confirmed by driver' with length
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a communication session with an RBC. The driver has confirmed train integrity. Valid train length and position are available.

steps.action: Trigger a position report (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the train integrity information in the position report.
steps.expected: The train integrity status is reported as 'Confirmed by driver'. The confirmed train length is included in the report.

test_cases.title: Report train integrity status as 'Confirmed by external source' with length
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a communication session with an RBC. Train integrity is confirmed by an external source. Valid train length and position are available.

steps.action: Trigger a position report (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the train integrity information in the position report.
steps.expected: The train integrity status is reported as 'Confirmed by external source'. The confirmed train length is included in the report.

test_cases.title: Report train integrity status as 'Lost' without length
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a communication session with an RBC. A loss of train integrity is detected.

steps.action: Trigger a position report (e.g., by reaching standstill or mode change).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the train integrity information in the position report.
steps.expected: The train integrity status is reported as 'Lost'. No confirmed train length is included in the report.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'No integrity information' to 'Confirmed by driver'
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a communication session with an RBC. Current integrity status is 'No integrity information'.

steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the internal train integrity status to 'Confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report contains the integrity status 'Confirmed by driver' and the confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Confirmed by driver' to 'Lost'
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a communication session with an RBC. Current integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: Simulate a loss of train integrity (e.g., via external signal or internal detection).
steps.expected: The OBU updates the internal train integrity status to 'Lost'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report contains the integrity status 'Lost' and no confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Confirmed by external source' to 'Confirmed by driver'
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a communication session with an RBC. Current integrity status is 'Confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the internal train integrity status to 'Confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report contains the integrity status 'Confirmed by driver' and the confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Initial status after session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is not in a communication session.

steps.action: Establish a successful communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sets the train integrity status to 'No integrity information'.

steps.action: Trigger the first position report after session establishment.
steps.expected: The position report contains the integrity status 'No integrity information'.

test_cases.title: Geographical position display on driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where geographical position information is available and valid. The geographical position display is currently not active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver request to display geographical position.

steps.action: Verify that the geographical position is not displayed on the HMI.
steps.expected: The geographical position is not visible on the driver display.

steps.action: The driver issues a request to display the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the geographical position of the estimated front end of the train in relation to the track kilometre.

test_cases.title: Stop geographical position display on driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The geographical position display is currently active and visible on the HMI.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver request to stop displaying geographical position.

steps.action: Verify that the geographical position is currently displayed on the HMI.
steps.expected: The geographical position is visible on the driver display.

steps.action: The driver issues a request to stop the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the geographical position. The position information is no longer visible on the driver display.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation includes distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has received and stored valid geographical position information (reference balise group, offset, track kilometre value, counting direction). The train is moving in the direction of the counting direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: A known distance travelled from the geographical reference location (e.g., 100 meters).
test_cases.assumptions: The odometer or distance measurement system is accurate for the test duration.

steps.action: Record the initial geographical position displayed or calculated by the OBU immediately after passing the reference point (distance travelled = 0).
steps.expected: The displayed position corresponds to the track kilometre reference value adjusted by the offset.

steps.action: Move the train a known distance (e.g., 100 meters) away from the geographical reference location in the counting direction.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the new geographical position by adding the 100 meters travelled to the previous position.

steps.action: Request the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The displayed track kilometre value reflects the initial position plus the 100 meters travelled.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation with reverse counting direction
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has received and stored valid geographical position information where the counting direction is opposite to the train's movement direction (or the train is moving against the counting direction).
test_cases.test_inputs: A known distance travelled from the geographical reference location (e.g., 50 meters) in the direction opposite to the counting direction.

steps.action: Move the train a known distance (e.g., 50 meters) from the geographical reference location in the direction opposite to the defined counting direction.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the geographical position by subtracting the 50 meters travelled from the reference position (or adding the distance with a negative sign relative to the counting direction).

steps.action: Request the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The displayed track kilometre value reflects the correct position accounting for the reverse direction of travel relative to the counting direction.

test_cases.title: Roll-away distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where Roll Away Protection supervision can be initiated (e.g., Standstill). The train is stationary at a known location not associated with a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: National/Default Value for Roll Away Protection distance (e.g., 10 m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a debug interface or log to observe the calculated 'remaining distance' and the 'estimated distance travelled'.

steps.action: Initiate the Roll Away Protection supervision function.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates and stores the remaining distance to be travelled as equal to the National/Default Value for Roll Away Protection.

steps.action: Move the train forward by a known distance (e.g., 2 m) using a test rig or simulation.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance by subtracting the estimated distance travelled (2 m) from the initial supervised distance.

test_cases.title: Post Trip reversing distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Post Trip mode. The train is stationary.
test_cases.test_inputs: National/Default Value for maximum distance for reversing in Post Trip mode (e.g., 5 m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the supervision state and remaining distance.

steps.action: Trigger the supervision for reversing in Post Trip mode.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled as equal to the National/Default Value for reversing in Post Trip mode.

steps.action: Move the train in the reversing direction by a known distance (e.g., 1 m).
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance by subtracting the estimated distance travelled from the initial supervised distance.

test_cases.title: Staff Responsible distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Staff Responsible (SR) mode. A valid distance value is available (e.g., from RBC or Driver input).
test_cases.test_inputs: SR distance value (e.g., 100 m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the virtual train front position and remaining distance.

steps.action: Enter Staff Responsible mode with a defined distance.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates supervision and calculates the remaining distance to be travelled as equal to the defined SR distance.

steps.action: Move the train forward by a known distance (e.g., 10 m).
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance based on the virtual train front position logic, subtracting the distance travelled from the supervised distance.

test_cases.title: Standstill supervision distance update with movement
test_cases.preconditions: Standstill supervision is active. The train is stationary.
test_cases.test_inputs: Standstill supervision distance (e.g., 1 m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the remaining distance.

steps.action: Verify the initial remaining distance for Standstill supervision.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is equal to the configured standstill supervision distance.

steps.action: Move the train by a small distance less than the supervision limit (e.g., 0.5 m).
steps.expected: The remaining distance is reduced by the estimated distance travelled. No safety reaction is triggered.

steps.action: Move the train further so that the total distance exceeds the supervision limit.
steps.expected: The remaining distance reaches zero or negative, and the OBU triggers the appropriate safety reaction (e.g., brake demand).

test_cases.title: Virtual train front position with odometer under-reading
test_cases.preconditions: Supervision for a distance requiring virtual front position (e.g., SR mode) is active. Odometer under-reading is simulated or configured.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised distance (e.g., 100 m), Odometer under-reading amount (e.g., 2 m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows injection of odometer error values or simulation of under-reading. The OBU exposes the 'max safe front end position' remaining distance.

steps.action: Start supervision with a known supervised distance.
steps.expected: The initial remaining distance from the max safe front end position is calculated as: Supervised Distance - Estimated Distance Travelled (0) - Odometer Under-reading (0 initially).

steps.action: Simulate odometer under-reading of 2 m and move the train by 10 m.
steps.expected: The remaining distance from the max safe front end position is calculated as: Supervised Distance - 10 m - 2 m. This value should be 2 m less than the remaining distance from the estimated front end position.

test_cases.title: Virtual train front position with odometer over-reading
test_cases.preconditions: Supervision for a distance requiring virtual front position (e.g., SR mode) is active. Odometer over-reading is simulated or configured.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised distance (e.g., 100 m), Odometer over-reading amount (e.g., 3 m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows injection of odometer error values or simulation of over-reading. The OBU exposes the 'min safe front end position' remaining distance.

steps.action: Start supervision with a known supervised distance.
steps.expected: The initial remaining distance from the min safe front end position is calculated as: Supervised Distance - Estimated Distance Travelled (0) + Odometer Over-reading (0 initially).

steps.action: Simulate odometer over-reading of 3 m and move the train by 10 m.
steps.expected: The remaining distance from the min safe front end position is calculated as: Supervised Distance - 10 m + 3 m. This value should be 3 m more than the remaining distance from the estimated front end position.

test_cases.title: Supervision re-start after Override in SR mode
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Staff Responsible mode with an active distance supervision. The train has moved some distance.
test_cases.test_inputs: New SR distance value (e.g., 50 m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the virtual train position reset.

steps.action: Move the train by 20 m in SR mode.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is reduced by 20 m.

steps.action: Trigger an update of the SR distance (e.g., via RBC or Driver input) to a new value.
steps.expected: The previous virtual train position is deleted. A new virtual train position is created at the current location. The remaining distance is reset to the new SR distance value.

test_cases.title: Zero distance supervision after Override without valid position
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in SB or PT mode. No valid train position is stored on-board. The Override function is triggered.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (zero distance supervision).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the supervision state for the former EOA/LOA.

steps.action: Trigger the Override function while no valid train position is stored.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates supervision of a zero distance to the former EOA/LOA.

steps.action: Move the train by any non-zero distance.
steps.expected: The remaining distance becomes negative, and the OBU triggers the trip condition or de-activates the Override as per the requirement.

test_cases.title: MA kabul edilmemesi: SSP/gradient MA uzunluğunu tam kapsamıyor (Non-infill)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2'de çalışmaktadır. Trende mevcut bir MA ve SSP/gradient verileri bulunmaktadır. Trende tahmini ön uç konumu bilinmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen yeni MA mesajı. Bu MA'nın SSP/gradient verileri, tahmini tren ön ucundan denetlenen konuma (supervised location) kadar olan mesafeyi tam olarak kapsamamaktadır (kısa bir mesafe eksik).
test_cases.assumptions: Tahmini tren ön ucu, mevcut SSP/gradient verisinin bittiği noktadan öndedir.

steps.action: RBC'den, SSP/gradient verileri MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (tahmini tren ön ucundan denetlenen konuma kadar) kapsamayan bir MA gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mode profile'ı (varsa) reddeder. Mevcut MA ve veriler geçerli kalmaya devam eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun durum ekranı veya log kayıtları incelenir.
steps.expected: MA kabul edilmemesinin nedeni olarak SSP/gradient kapsam yetersizliği görülebilir. Sistem, yeni MA'yı aktif olarak kullanmaz.

test_cases.title: MA kabul edilmemesi: SSP/gradient MA uzunluğunu tam kapsamıyor (Infill)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2'de çalışmaktadır. Trende mevcut bir MA ve SSP/gradient verileri bulunmaktadır. Infill konumu referansı (infill location reference) tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen yeni Infill MA mesajı. Bu MA'nın SSP/gradient verileri, infill konumu referansından denetlenen konuma (supervised location) kadar olan mesafeyi tam olarak kapsamamaktadır.
test_cases.assumptions: Infill konumu referansı, mevcut SSP/gradient verisinin bittiği noktadan öndedir.

steps.action: RBC'den, SSP/gradient verileri MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (infill konumu referansından denetlenen konuma kadar) kapsamayan bir Infill MA gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mode profile'ı (varsa) reddeder. Mevcut MA ve veriler geçerli kalmaya devam eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun durum ekranı veya log kayıtları incelenir.
steps.expected: MA kabul edilmemesinin nedeni olarak SSP/gradient kapsam yetersizliği görülebilir. Sistem, yeni MA'yı aktif olarak kullanmaz.

test_cases.title: MA kabul edilmemesi: SSP/gradient MA uzunluğunu tam kapsamıyor (Ters yön)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2'de çalışmaktadır. Trende mevcut bir MA ve SSP/gradient verileri bulunmaktadır. Trende yeni bir yön (orientation) atanmıştır ve bu yön mevcut tren yönünün tersidir.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen, Supervised Manoeuvre yetkisinin parçası olan ve geçerlilik yönü mevcut tren yönünün tersi olan bir MA. Bu MA'nın SSP/gradient verileri, yeni tren yönünden türetilen tahmini tren ön ucundan denetlenen konuma kadar olan mesafeyi tam olarak kapsamamaktadır.
test_cases.assumptions: Yeni tren yönünden türetilen tahmini tren ön ucu, mevcut SSP/gradient verisinin bittiği noktadan öndedir.

steps.action: RBC'den, SSP/gradient verileri MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (yeni yön için tahmini tren ön ucundan denetlenen konuma kadar) kapsamayan bir MA gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mode profile'ı (varsa) reddeder. Mevcut MA ve veriler geçerli kalmaya devam eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun durum ekranı veya log kayıtları incelenir.
steps.expected: MA kabul edilmemesinin nedeni olarak SSP/gradient kapsam yetersizliği görülebilir. Sistem, yeni MA'yı aktif olarak kullanmaz.

test_cases.title: MA kabul edilmesi: SSP/gradient MA uzunluğunu tam kapsıyor (Normal)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2'de çalışmaktadır. Trende mevcut bir MA ve SSP/gradient verileri bulunmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen yeni MA mesajı. Bu MA'nın SSP/gradient verileri, tahmini tren ön ucundan denetlenen konuma (supervised location) kadar olan mesafeyi tam olarak kapsamaktadır.

steps.action: RBC'den, SSP/gradient verileri MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (tahmini tren ön ucundan denetlenen konuma kadar) kapsayan bir MA gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mode profile'ı (varsa) kabul eder. Yeni MA aktif hale gelir.

steps.action: OBU'nun durum ekranı incelenir.
steps.expected: Yeni MA'nın geçerli olduğu ve SSP/gradient verilerinin tamamının yüklendiği görülmelidir.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Route Suitability Loading Gauge Information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode and has stored route suitability loading gauge information for a specific route section.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new track description message containing updated route suitability loading gauge information.
test_cases.assumptions: The new information is valid and received via a valid balise or radio link.

steps.action: Transmit a new track description message containing new route suitability loading gauge information to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the message and replaces all previously stored route suitability loading gauge information with the new data.

steps.action: Query the OBU's internal state for route suitability loading gauge information.
steps.expected: The stored information matches the new data completely, and no old data remains.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Adhesion Factor Information from Start Location
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored adhesion factor information for a track section starting at location L1.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new track description message containing new adhesion factor information starting at location L2 (where L2 > L1).
test_cases.assumptions: Location L2 is within the range of the previously stored information.

steps.action: Transmit a new track description message containing new adhesion factor information starting at location L2.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the stored adhesion factor information from location L2 onwards with the new data.

steps.action: Query the OBU's internal state for adhesion factor information between L1 and L2.
steps.expected: The original stored information remains unchanged between L1 and L2.

steps.action: Query the OBU's internal state for adhesion factor information from L2 onwards.
steps.expected: The stored information from L2 onwards matches the new data.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Linking Information (Non-Infill) from Reference Balise Group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored linking information associated with a reference balise group BG_A.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new non-infill linking information message with a reference balise group BG_B.
test_cases.assumptions: BG_B is a valid balise group identifier.

steps.action: Transmit a new non-infill linking information message referencing balise group BG_B.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all stored linking information from the reference balise group BG_B onwards with the new data.

steps.action: Query the OBU's internal state for linking information associated with BG_B and subsequent groups.
steps.expected: The stored linking information matches the new data for BG_B and subsequent groups.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Linking Information (Infill) from Reference Location
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new infill linking information message with a reference location (balise group at next main signal).
test_cases.assumptions: The infill information is correctly formatted and valid.

steps.action: Transmit a new infill linking information message with a specific reference location.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all stored linking information from the reference location onwards with the new data.

steps.action: Query the OBU's internal state for linking information from the reference location onwards.
steps.expected: The stored linking information matches the new infill data.

test_cases.title: Resumption of Initial State for PBD Speed Restrictions
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored Speed Restriction to ensure Permitted Braking Distance (PBD) information beyond a specific location L.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside request to resume initial state for PBD speed restrictions beyond location L.
test_cases.assumptions: Location L is a valid track position.

steps.action: Send a trackside request to resume initial state for PBD speed restrictions beyond location L.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the request and resumes the initial state for PBD speed restrictions beyond location L.

steps.action: Query the OBU's internal state for PBD speed restrictions beyond location L.
steps.expected: The PBD speed restriction information beyond location L is in its initial state (e.g., no restriction or default value).

test_cases.title: Resumption of Initial State for Axle Load Speed Profiles
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored axle load speed profile information beyond a specific location L.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside request to resume initial state for axle load speed profiles beyond location L.
test_cases.assumptions: Location L is a valid track position.

steps.action: Send a trackside request to resume initial state for axle load speed profiles beyond location L.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the request and resumes the initial state for axle load speed profiles beyond location L.

steps.action: Query the OBU's internal state for axle load speed profiles beyond location L.
steps.expected: The axle load speed profile information beyond location L is in its initial state.

test_cases.title: Resumption of Initial State for Grouped Track Condition Types
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored track condition information for types such as sound horn, non-stopping area, tunnel stopping area, etc., beyond a specific location L.
test_cases.test_inputs: A single trackside request to resume initial state for all listed track condition types beyond location L.
test_cases.assumptions: The request includes the correct list of track condition types as per SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.2 c).

steps.action: Send a single trackside request to resume initial state for the listed track condition types beyond location L.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the request and resumes the initial state for all specified track condition types beyond location L.

steps.action: Query the OBU's internal state for the specified track condition types beyond location L.
steps.expected: All specified track condition types beyond location L are in their initial states.

test_cases.title: Resumption of Initial State for Route Suitability Data
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored route suitability information beyond a specific location L.
test_cases.test_inputs: A single trackside request to resume initial state for all stored route suitability information beyond location L.
test_cases.assumptions: The request is valid and targets the correct location.

steps.action: Send a single trackside request to resume initial state for all stored route suitability information beyond location L.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the request and resumes the initial state for all route suitability information beyond location L.

steps.action: Query the OBU's internal state for route suitability information beyond location L.
steps.expected: All route suitability information beyond location L is in its initial state.

test_cases.title: Resumption of Initial State for Station Platform Track Conditions
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored Station Platform track condition information beyond a specific location L.
test_cases.test_inputs: A single trackside request to resume initial state for all stored Station Platform track condition information beyond location L.
test_cases.assumptions: The request is valid and targets the correct location.

steps.action: Send a single trackside request to resume initial state for all stored Station Platform track condition information beyond location L.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the request and resumes the initial state for all Station Platform track condition information beyond location L.

steps.action: Query the OBU's internal state for Station Platform track condition information beyond location L.
steps.expected: All Station Platform track condition information beyond location L is in its initial state.

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre with Same Validity Direction as Train Orientation
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode with a current train orientation and stored location-based information.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with a validity direction matching the current train orientation.
test_cases.assumptions: The current train orientation is known and the new MA validity direction is set to match it.

steps.action: Transmit a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with a validity direction matching the current train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the normal replacement rules of SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1 for the new Movement Authority.

steps.action: Query the OBU's internal state for location-based information.
steps.expected: The location-based information is updated according to the normal replacement rules, not deleted.

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre with Opposite Validity Direction to Train Orientation
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode with a current train orientation and stored location-based information.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with a validity direction opposite to the current train orientation.
test_cases.assumptions: The current train orientation is known and the new MA validity direction is set to be opposite.

steps.action: Transmit a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with a validity direction opposite to the current train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU does not apply the normal replacement rules and deletes all previously stored location-based information.

steps.action: Query the OBU's internal state for location-based information.
steps.expected: All previously stored location-based information is deleted or in its initial state.

test_cases.title: MA request includes all applicable reasons
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with the RBC is established. The OBU is configured to send MA requests.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated conditions to trigger multiple MA request reasons simultaneously (e.g., driver selects 'Start' and a Section timer is about to expire).
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment allows monitoring of the MA request message content sent to the RBC.

steps.action: Configure the OBU such that two or more MA request reasons are applicable simultaneously (e.g., driver selects 'Start' and the time before a Section timer expires is reached).
steps.expected: The OBU prepares an MA request.

steps.action: Trigger the MA request transmission.
steps.expected: The MA request message sent to the RBC contains all applicable MA request reasons (e.g., 'Start selected by driver' and 'Time before a Section timer/LOA speed timer expires reached').

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by passing perturbation location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. MA request parameters for perturbation location are received from the RBC. The train is moving towards a defined perturbation location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed and position data simulating the train front passing the calculated perturbation location.
test_cases.assumptions: The perturbation location and warning speed are known and configured in the test scenario.

steps.action: Move the train such that the train front approaches the location defined by the perturbation-location criterion (time before reaching perturbation location at warning speed).
steps.expected: No MA request is sent yet.

steps.action: Continue moving the train until the train front passes the calculated perturbation location.
steps.expected: An MA request is triggered and sent to the RBC with the reason 'Time before reaching the perturbation location reached'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by Section timer criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. MA request parameters for Section timer are received from the RBC. A Section timer is active and supervised.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time simulation to reach the defined time before the Section timer expires.
test_cases.assumptions: The Section timer value and the defined time before expiration are known.

steps.action: Wait until the time before the Section timer expires reaches the defined triggering time criterion.
steps.expected: An MA request is triggered and sent to the RBC with the reason 'Time before a Section timer/LOA speed timer expires reached'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by track description deletion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A valid track description is loaded. The OBU is connected to the RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: A track description update that results in the deletion of a part of the track description under a situation not excluded (e.g., situation c of A.3.4).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific situation in A.3.4 used for deletion is not a, b, f, or k.

steps.action: Apply a track description update that deletes a part of the track description under a non-excluded situation (e.g., situation c).
steps.expected: An MA request is sent to the RBC with the reason 'Track description deletion'.

test_cases.title: No MA request for excluded track description deletion situations
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A valid track description is loaded. The OBU is connected to the RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: A track description update that results in the deletion of a part of the track description under an excluded situation (e.g., situation a of A.3.4).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific situation in A.3.4 used for deletion is one of a, b, f, or k.

steps.action: Apply a track description update that deletes a part of the track description under an excluded situation (e.g., situation a).
steps.expected: No MA request is sent to the RBC with the reason 'Track description deletion'.

test_cases.title: End Section timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an End Section timer start location ahead of the train is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA containing End Section timer start location and time-out value.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving towards the End Section timer start location.

steps.action: Move the train such that its max safe front end is just before the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer is not started (value is 0 or inactive).

steps.action: Move the train such that its max safe front end passes the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts counting.

test_cases.title: End Section timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: End Section timer is running. The train is moving within the End Section. The current target speed at the End of MA is non-zero (LOA).
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with End Section timer time-out value set to a short duration (e.g., 10 seconds) for testability.
test_cases.assumptions: The train does not pass the End Section timer stop location before the timeout.

steps.action: Wait for the End Section timer value to exceed the time-out value given by trackside.
steps.expected: The EOA/LOA is withdrawn to the current position of the train. The location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. The target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2. A new MA message is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA message with a specific time stamp T_msg.
test_cases.assumptions: The system clock is synchronized with the trackside time.

steps.action: Receive the MA message containing the LOA speed.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the time stamp T_msg of the message.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 1. The train is approaching a balise group that provides the MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group with variable information containing the MA and LOA speed.
test_cases.assumptions: The train passes the first balise of the group at time T_pass.

steps.action: Pass the first encountered balise of the balise group giving the MA.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the moment of passage over the first balise (T_pass).

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: LOA speed timer is running. The current MA has a non-zero target speed at the End of MA (LOA).
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with LOA speed time-out value set to a short duration for testability.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is in Full Supervision mode.

steps.action: Wait for the LOA speed timer value to exceed the time-out value received from trackside.
steps.expected: The speed associated with the LOA is set to zero. The LOA becomes an EOA. The Supervised Location is defined per §3.8.4.5. The location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted accordingly.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an Overlap timer start location ahead of the train is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA containing Overlap timer start location and a finite time-out value.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving towards the Overlap timer start location.

steps.action: Move the train such that its max safe front end is just before the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is not started.

steps.action: Move the train such that its max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer starts counting.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start with infinite time-out value
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an Overlap timer start location ahead of the train is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA containing Overlap timer start location and time-out value set to 'infinite'.

steps.action: Move the train such that its max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is considered as started, even though the time-out value is 'infinite'.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer is running. The current MA includes an Overlap with a release speed. The target speed at the End of MA is non-zero.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with Overlap timer time-out value set to a short duration for testability.

steps.action: Wait for the Overlap timer value to exceed the time-out value given by trackside.
steps.expected: The overlap information is deleted. The release speed associated with the Overlap is deleted. The Supervised Location is redetermined per §3.8.4.5. The location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. The non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiration upon train standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer has been started. The train is moving.
test_cases.assumptions: The train comes to a standstill before the Overlap timer naturally expires.

steps.action: Bring the train to a standstill after the Overlap timer has been started.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the Overlap timer value as greater than its time-out value. The consequences defined in §3.8.4.4.2 are applied (overlap deleted, release speed deleted, SvL redetermined, target speed at EoMA set to zero).

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiration upon receiving new MA with rear start location
test_cases.preconditions: No Overlap timer is currently running. The train is in Full Supervision mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA with an Overlap timer start location located in rear of the train's max safe front end.

steps.action: Receive the new MA with the Overlap timer start location in rear of the max safe front end.
steps.expected: The OBU considers that the Overlap timer value has exceeded its time-out value. The consequences defined in §3.8.4.4.2 are applied.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with valid Overlap
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in Full Supervision mode. The current MA includes an Overlap that has not timed out.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with a valid Overlap.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) determined by the OBU.
steps.expected: The SvL is set to the end of the overlap.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with timed-out Overlap and Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in Full Supervision mode. The Overlap has timed out. The current MA includes a Danger Point.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with a Danger Point and no valid Overlap.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) determined by the OBU.
steps.expected: The SvL is set to the Danger Point.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with no Overlap or Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in Full Supervision mode. The current MA has no Overlap and no Danger Point. It has an End Section.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with an End Section but no Overlap or Danger Point.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) determined by the OBU.
steps.expected: The SvL is set to the end of the End Section.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Full Supervision mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information is available for the main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Automatic Driving mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Automatic Driving mode. Linking information is available for the main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Limited Supervision mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Limited Supervision mode. Linking information is available for the main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA rejection in Standstill mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Standstill mode (not Full Supervision, Automatic Driving, or Limited Supervision).
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation with available linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information is available for the main signal balise group to which the infill MA refers.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message referring to a main signal balise group with available linking info.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA rejection without linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information is NOT available for the main signal balise group to which the infill MA refers.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA message referring to a main signal balise group without available linking info.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Replacement of MA data from RBC (Non-infill)
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a valid MA received previously. The train is in a state where it can receive a new MA from the RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA message from the RBC with different data (e.g., different SvL, different sections) than the currently supervised MA.

steps.action: Transmit a new MA from the RBC to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA.

steps.action: Inspect the internal MA data structure of the OBU.
steps.expected: All data of the previous MA has been replaced by the data of the new MA. No remnants of the previous MA exist.

test_cases.title: Replacement of MA data from Main Signal Balise (Non-infill)
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a valid MA. The train approaches a main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group message at a main signal containing a new MA (non-infill) with different data than the current MA.

steps.action: Pass the main signal balise group containing the new MA.
steps.expected: The OBU reads the balise message and accepts the new MA.

steps.action: Inspect the internal MA data structure of the OBU.
steps.expected: All data of the previous MA has been replaced by the data of the new MA.

test_cases.title: Partial replacement of MA data from Infill Information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a valid MA with multiple sections. The train is before the next main signal.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA message (e.g., from a loop or radio) referring to the next main signal balise group, with data different from the current MA for sections beyond that signal.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking information for the next main signal balise group is available.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA message.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the infill MA.

steps.action: Inspect the internal MA data structure of the OBU.
steps.expected: Data for sections up to and including the announced balise group at the next main signal remains unchanged from the previous MA. Data for all sections beyond the announced balise group is replaced by the new infill data.

test_cases.title: Start of new MA section at infill location reference
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a valid MA. The train is approaching the next main signal.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA message referring to the next main signal balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking information for the next main signal balise group is available.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA message.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the infill MA.

steps.action: Inspect the MA section structure in the OBU.
steps.expected: A new MA section starts at the infill location reference, which corresponds to the balise group at the next main signal. The section before this reference remains part of the previous MA structure or is handled according to the non-infill replacement rules, but the new section boundary is established at the infill location.

test_cases.title: MA Shortening when switching from LOA to SvL
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising an MA ending with an LOA (Limit of Authority).
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA message (from RBC or Balise) defining an SvL (Stop Location) at any position.

steps.action: Receive the new MA defining an SvL.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state regarding MA shortening.
steps.expected: The OBU treats this event as an MA shortening.

steps.action: Inspect the stored location-based information.
steps.expected: The location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 that is no longer valid due to the shortening has been deleted.

test_cases.title: MA Shortening when switching from LOA to SvL (SvL further than LOA)
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising an MA ending with an LOA at position X.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA message defining an SvL at position Y, where Y > X (further ahead than the previous LOA).

steps.action: Receive the new MA defining an SvL further ahead than the previous LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state regarding MA shortening.
steps.expected: The OBU treats this event as an MA shortening, regardless of the SvL location being further than the previous LOA.

steps.action: Inspect the stored location-based information.
steps.expected: The location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 is deleted accordingly.

test_cases.title: No MA Shortening on Repositioning Information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a valid MA. Linking information has announced a following balise group as unknown but containing repositioning information.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group message containing repositioning information.

steps.action: Receive the repositioning information.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the length of the current MA section.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state regarding MA shortening.
steps.expected: The OBU does not treat this event as an MA shortening. No location-based information is deleted due to shortening.

test_cases.title: No MA Shortening on New MA with LOA
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a valid MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA message (from RBC or Balise) ending with an LOA.

steps.action: Receive the new MA ending with an LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state regarding MA shortening.
steps.expected: The OBU does not treat this event as an MA shortening. No location-based information is deleted due to shortening.

test_cases.title: MA kısaltma isteğinin kabulü (Tren sınırı gerisinde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA ve ilgili mod profili ile SH alanı balise grubu listesine sahiptir. RBC ile iletişim kurulmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA kısaltma isteği: Önerilen kısaltılmış MA'nın Indication supervision limit'i, trenin ön ucunun mevcut konumunun gerisinde olacak şekilde ayarlanır. İsteğe mod profili ve SH alanı balise grubu listesi eklenir.
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin ön ucunun konumu OBU tarafından doğru olarak hesaplanmaktadır.

steps.action: RBC, trenin ön ucunun önerilen MA'nın Indication supervision limit'inden gerisinde olduğu bir senaryoda MA kısaltma isteği gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, isteği kabul eder. OBU, önerilen kısaltılmış MA'yı, eklenen mod profilini ve SH alanı balise grubu listesini yeni geçerli MA olarak kabul eder ve depolar.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği yanıt mesajı gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye isteğin kabul edildiğini bildiren bir onay mesajı gönderir.

test_cases.title: MA kısaltma isteğinin reddi (Tren sınırı önünde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA ve ilgili mod profili ile SH alanı balise grubu listesine sahiptir. RBC ile iletişim kurulmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA kısaltma isteği: Önerilen kısaltılmış MA'nın Indication supervision limit'i, trenin ön ucunun mevcut konumunun önünde olacak şekilde ayarlanır. İsteğe mod profili ve SH alanı balise grubu listesi eklenir.
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin ön ucunun konumu OBU tarafından doğru olarak hesaplanmaktadır.

steps.action: RBC, trenin ön ucunun önerilen MA'nın Indication supervision limit'inden önde olduğu bir senaryoda MA kısaltma isteği gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, isteği reddeder. OBU, mevcut MA'yı, mevcut mod profilini ve mevcut SH alanı balise grubu listesini geçerli olarak korur. Yeni MA kabul edilmez.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği yanıt mesajı gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye isteğin reddedildiğini bildiren bir mesaj gönderir.

test_cases.title: MA kısaltma isteğinin kabulü (Sınır durumu: Tren sınırı üzerinde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA'ya sahiptir. RBC ile iletişim kurulmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA kısaltma isteği: Önerilen kısaltılmış MA'nın Indication supervision limit'i, trenin ön ucunun mevcut konumuyla tam olarak aynı konumda olacak şekilde ayarlanır.
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin ön ucunun konumu OBU tarafından doğru olarak hesaplanmaktadır. 'In rear' (geride) ifadesi, sınırın tam üzerinde olma durumunu da kapsar veya sınırın gerisinde olma durumunu ifade eder; burada sınırın gerisinde veya üzerinde kabul edileceği varsayılır (genellikle 'in rear' <= anlamına gelir, ancak gereksinim 'in rear' der. Eğer 'in rear' strictly < ise bu test reddedilir. Ancak ERTMS'te genellikle sınır dahil edilir veya 'in rear' ifadesi 'not in advance' olarak yorumlanır. Güvenli tarafta kalmak için, sınırın gerisinde veya üzerinde kabul edileceği varsayımı yapılır. Eğer gereksinim 'in rear'ı sadece < olarak tanımlıyorsa, bu test reddi testine dönüşür. Ancak 'in advance' reddi açıkça belirtilmiş. 'In rear' kabulü. Sınırda, tren sınırı geçmemiştir. Bu nedenle kabul edilmelidir.

steps.action: RBC, trenin ön ucunun önerilen MA'nın Indication supervision limit'iyle aynı konumda olduğu bir senaryoda MA kısaltma isteği gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, isteği kabul eder (tren sınırı önünde değildir). OBU, önerilen kısaltılmış MA'yı yeni geçerli MA olarak kabul eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği yanıt mesajı gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye isteğin kabul edildiğini bildiren bir onay mesajı gönderir.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area start indication based on estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode. A tunnel stopping area is stored in the on-board data with a defined start location (Point D). The train is moving towards the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 100 km/h. Distance to tunnel stopping area start: 500 m. Estimated front end position calculated by OBU.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly calculates the estimated front end position based on current speed and driver reaction time parameters defined in Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end of the train reaches the calculated Point C (in rear of Point D) for the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the 'Tunnel Stopping Area announcement' to the driver.

steps.action: Continue moving the train until the estimated front end reaches the start location (Point D) of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the display to show the 'Tunnel Stopping Area' indication (or continues the announcement as per specific UI logic, but the condition for display initiation was met at Point C).

test_cases.title: Sound horn indication start based on estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode. A 'Sound Horn' track condition area is stored in the on-board data with a defined start location (Point D). The train is moving towards the sound horn area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 80 km/h. Distance to sound horn area start: 400 m. Estimated front end position calculated by OBU.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly calculates the estimated front end position based on current speed and driver reaction time parameters defined in Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end of the train reaches the calculated Point C (in rear of Point D) for the sound horn area.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the 'Sound Horn' indication to the driver.

steps.action: Continue moving the train until the estimated front end reaches the start location (Point D) of the sound horn area.
steps.expected: The 'Sound Horn' indication remains displayed.

test_cases.title: Sound horn indication end based on estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The 'Sound Horn' indication is currently displayed on the driver's display. The train is within the sound horn area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 80 km/h. Distance to end of sound horn area (Point E): 100 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly calculates the estimated front end position.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end of the train reaches the end location (Point E) of the sound horn area.
steps.expected: The 'Sound Horn' indication is no longer displayed to the driver.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of track condition boundaries at high speed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode. A tunnel stopping area is stored. The train is approaching at a high speed where the distance between Point C and Point D is significant.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 200 km/h. Tunnel stopping area start location defined.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU uses the maximum safe front end or estimated front end as specified for this track condition type (estimated front end per ETC-095).

steps.action: Simulate the train position such that the physical front end is before Point C, but the estimated front end (accounting for speed/reaction time) has passed Point C.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the tunnel stopping area announcement, confirming it uses the estimated front end rather than the physical front end for the trigger.

test_cases.title: No indication if estimated front end is beyond permitted supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode. A tunnel stopping area is stored. The train is approaching at a speed such that the estimated front end is in advance of the Permitted supervision limit calculated for the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 250 km/h. Tunnel stopping area start location defined such that the braking distance exceeds the available distance.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU calculates the Permitted supervision limit based on the SBD curve and estimated speed.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end is in advance of the Permitted supervision limit for the current tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: No information related to this tunnel stopping area is displayed to the driver.

steps.action: Check if the next tunnel stopping area (if any) is evaluated.
steps.expected: The OBU checks the next tunnel stopping area stored on-board, if any.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: Loading gauge unsuitability
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. Train Data is configured with a specific loading gauge profile (e.g., 'G1').
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside containing a list of accepted loading gauges that does NOT include the train's current loading gauge ('G1').
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows injection of simulated trackside messages for testing.

steps.action: Inject route suitability data from trackside where the list of accepted loading gauges excludes the train's current loading gauge.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and identifies a loading gauge unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status and driver interface.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the unsuitability to exist. The driver is informed about the unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: Axle load category unsuitability
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. Train Data is configured with a specific axle load category (e.g., 'A').
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside containing a list of permitted axle load categories that does NOT include the train's current axle load category ('A').
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows injection of simulated trackside messages for testing.

steps.action: Inject route suitability data from trackside where the list of permitted axle load categories excludes the train's current axle load category.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and identifies an axle load category unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status and driver interface.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the unsuitability to exist. The driver is informed about the unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: Traction system unsuitability
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. Train Data is configured with a specific traction system (e.g., 'Electric 25kV'). The engine is NOT capable of running on a line without any traction system.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside containing a list of accepted traction systems that does NOT include the train's current traction system.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows injection of simulated trackside messages for testing.

steps.action: Inject route suitability data from trackside where the list of accepted traction systems excludes the train's current traction system.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and identifies a traction system unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status and driver interface.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the unsuitability to exist. The driver is informed about the unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: All parameters suitable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. Train Data is configured with specific loading gauge, axle load category, and traction system.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside where all lists (loading gauges, axle load categories, traction systems) include the train's corresponding parameters.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows injection of simulated trackside messages for testing.

steps.action: Inject route suitability data from trackside where all train parameters are included in the accepted/permitted lists.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and finds no unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status and driver interface.
steps.expected: No unsuitability is reported. The train is permitted to run without restriction from route suitability.

test_cases.title: Traction system unsuitability exception: Engine can run without traction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. Train Data is configured with a specific traction system. The engine is configured/capable of running on a line without any traction system.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside containing a list of accepted traction systems that does NOT include the train's current traction system.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows injection of simulated trackside messages for testing. The engine capability is correctly reflected in the OBU configuration or Train Data.

steps.action: Inject route suitability data from trackside where the list of accepted traction systems excludes the train's current traction system.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data.

steps.action: Observe the OBU status regarding traction system suitability.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT find a traction system unsuitability, despite the mismatch, because the engine can run on a line without any traction system.

test_cases.title: No route suitability data: Initial state and operation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in operational mode. No route suitability data has been received from trackside.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (absence of data).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows monitoring of internal state and supervision logic.

steps.action: Verify the OBU's initial state regarding route suitability.
steps.expected: The OBU's initial state indicates that no route suitability restriction exists.

steps.action: Allow the train to run without receiving any route suitability data from trackside.
steps.expected: The OBU allows the train to run.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's supervision logic for route suitability.
steps.expected: The OBU does not use or supervise any default route suitability values.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for auxiliary information without acknowledgement

steps.action: Send a text message to the OBU with class 'auxiliary information' and no driver acknowledgement request.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for important information with acknowledgement

test_cases.title: Start condition with multiple sub-conditions (OR logic)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and display text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with two start sub-conditions (e.g., location and speed) defined with 'OR' logic.

steps.action: Send a text message with two start sub-conditions defined as 'OR'. Fulfill only the first sub-condition.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the start condition fulfilled and displays the message.

test_cases.title: Start condition with multiple sub-conditions (AND logic)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and display text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with two start sub-conditions (e.g., location and speed) defined with 'AND' logic.

steps.action: Fulfill the second sub-condition while the first remains fulfilled.

test_cases.title: Start condition with no sub-conditions
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and display text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with no start sub-conditions defined.

steps.action: Send a text message with no start sub-conditions defined.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the start condition as fulfilled immediately and displays the message.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement ends display regardless of end condition
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is displaying a text message that requests driver acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with driver acknowledgement defined as 'always ending the text display'.

steps.action: Display a text message with driver acknowledgement defined as 'always ending the text display'.
steps.expected: The message is displayed.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message before the end condition is fulfilled.
steps.expected: The text display ends immediately.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement as necessary condition for ending display
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is displaying a text message that requests driver acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with driver acknowledgement defined as 'necessary condition to end the text display'.

steps.action: Display a text message with driver acknowledgement defined as 'necessary condition to end the text display'.
steps.expected: The message is displayed.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message before the end condition is fulfilled.
steps.expected: The text display continues.

steps.action: Fulfill the end condition.
steps.expected: The text display ends.

test_cases.title: End condition fulfilled immediately upon start
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and display text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with start and end conditions such that the end condition is already fulfilled when the start condition is fulfilled.

steps.action: Send a text message where the end condition is already fulfilled at the moment the start condition is fulfilled.
steps.expected: The OBU does not display the message at all.

test_cases.title: End condition using location sub-condition
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where it can receive and display text messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: A text message with start condition using location and end condition using location.

steps.action: Send a text message with start condition using location A and end condition using location B.
steps.expected: The OBU measures the length over which the text is displayed from location A.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement report sent to RBC

steps.expected: The OBU sends a driver acknowledgement report including the text message identifier to the referenced RBC.

test_cases.title: Rejection of duplicate text message identifier
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has received a text message with a specific identifier that has not yet been acknowledged by the driver.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new text message with the same identifier as the previously received unacknowledged message.

steps.action: Receive a text message with identifier X that is not yet acknowledged.
steps.expected: The message is accepted and displayed.

steps.action: Receive a new text message with the same identifier X.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new text message.
