steps.expected: Yetkisiz değişiklik denemesi saptandığı için kuruluşça belirlenen sorumlulara uyarı gönderildiği görülür.

test_cases.title: Parola girişinde maskelenme kontrolü
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı portal giriş ekranındadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli bir parola.

steps.action: Parola alanına geçerli bir parola girilir.
steps.expected: Parola karakterleri ekranda maskelenmiş (örneğin yıldız veya nokta) olarak görünür, düz metin olarak okunamaz.

test_cases.title: Tek kullanımlık kod girişinde maskelenme kontrolü
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı çok faktörlü kimlik doğrulama adımındadır ve tek kullanımlık kod alanı aktiftir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli bir tek kullanımlık kod.

steps.action: Tek kullanımlık kod alanına geçerli bir kod girilir.
steps.expected: Kod karakterleri ekranda maskelenmiş olarak görünür, düz metin olarak okunamaz.

test_cases.title: Hassas işlemde tazelik süresi dolmuşsa yeniden doğrulama zorunluluğu
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı oturum açmıştır. Son tam kimlik doğrulama işlemi 5 dakikadan uzun bir süre önce yapılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Hassas işlem: E-posta değişikliği.
test_cases.assumptions: Tazelik süresi 5 dakika olarak tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı e-posta değişikliği işlemine başlar.
steps.expected: Sistem işlemi durdurur ve kullanıcıyı tam kimlik doğrulama (e-Devlet yönlendirmesi veya benzeri) için yönlendirir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı yeniden kimlik doğrulamayı başarıyla tamamlar.
steps.expected: Kullanıcı e-posta değişikliği ekranına yönlendirilir ve işlemi gerçekleştirebilir.

test_cases.title: Hassas işlemde tazelik süresi içindeyse yeniden doğrulama istenmemesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı oturum açmıştır. Son tam kimlik doğrulama işlemi 5 dakikadan kısa bir süre önce yapılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Hassas işlem: E-posta değişikliği.
test_cases.assumptions: Tazelik süresi 5 dakika olarak tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı e-posta değişikliği işlemine başlar.
steps.expected: Sistem yeniden kimlik doğrulama istemez ve kullanıcı doğrudan e-posta değişikliği ekranına yönlendirilir.

test_cases.title: Hassas işlemde tazelik süresi sınırında yeniden doğrulama kontrolü
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı oturum açmıştır. Son tam kimlik doğrulama işlemi tam olarak 5 dakika önce yapılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Hassas işlem: Telefon değişikliği.
test_cases.assumptions: Tazelik süresi 5 dakika olarak tanımlanmıştır ve süre dolunca doğrulama zorunludur.

steps.action: Kullanıcı telefon değişikliği işlemine başlar.
steps.expected: Sistem işlemi durdurur ve kullanıcıyı tam kimlik doğrulama için yönlendirir.

test_cases.title: Hassas işlemde yeniden doğrulama reddedilirse işlemin engellenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı oturum açmıştır. Son tam kimlik doğrulama işlemi 5 dakikadan uzun bir süre önce yapılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Hassas işlem: Kurtarma kodu yenileme.

steps.action: Kullanıcı kurtarma kodu yenileme işlemine başlar.
steps.expected: Sistem yeniden kimlik doğrulama ister.

steps.action: Kullanıcı yeniden kimlik doğrulamayı reddeder veya başarısız olur.
steps.expected: Kurtarma kodu yenileme işlemi gerçekleştirilemez ve kullanıcı işlem ekranından çıkarılır veya hata mesajı gösterilir.

test_cases.title: Tarayıcı ile portal arasındaki iletişimin şifreli olduğu doğrulanır
test_cases.preconditions: Portal test ortamında çalışmaktadır ve HTTPS erişimi açıktır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli bir kullanıcı oturumu başlatmak için gerekli girdiler.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8 gereksinimlerini karşılamak için TLS protokolünü kullanmaktadır.

steps.action: Tarayıcıda portal adresine HTTPS protokolü ile erişilir.
steps.expected: Bağlantı kurulur ve tarayıcı adres çubuğunda güvenli bağlantı simgesi (kilit ikonu) görünür.

steps.action: Tarayıcı geliştirici araçları üzerinden ağ trafiği incelenir.
steps.expected: Tarayıcı ile sunucu arasında iletilen verilerin şifreli olduğu, açık metin olarak görülmeyen TLS paketleri şeklinde olduğu gözlemlenir.

test_cases.title: Sunucular arası iletişimin şifreli olduğu doğrulanır
test_cases.preconditions: Portalın backend servisleri (örneğin uygulama sunucusu ve veritabanı sunucusu) test ortamında çalışmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Portal üzerinden veritabanına yazılacak veya okunacak basit bir test verisi.
test_cases.assumptions: Sunucular arası iletişim için TLS veya IPSec gibi şifreleme mekanizmaları yapılandırılmıştır.

steps.action: Portal üzerinden veritabanına yazılacak bir işlem başlatılır.
steps.expected: İşlem başarıyla tamamlanır.

steps.action: Uygulama sunucusu ile veritabanı sunucusu arasındaki ağ trafiği yakalanır ve incelenir.
steps.expected: Sunucular arasında iletilen verilerin şifreli olduğu, açık metin olarak görülmeyen şifreli paketler şeklinde olduğu gözlemlenir.

test_cases.title: Şifreleme yapılandırılmamışsa iletişimin engellenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Portal test ortamında çalışmaktadır. Sunucu yapılandırması geçici olarak HTTP (şifresiz) erişimine izin verecek şekilde değiştirilmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Portal adresine HTTP protokolü ile erişim denemesi.
test_cases.assumptions: Sistem, güvenli olmayan bağlantıları reddetmek veya yönlendirmek üzere yapılandırılmıştır.

steps.action: Tarayıcıda portal adresine HTTP protokolü ile erişilmeye çalışılır.
steps.expected: Sistem, güvenli olmayan bağlantıyı reddeder veya kullanıcıyı otomatik olarak HTTPS adresine yönlendirir. Açık metin üzerinden veri alışverişi gerçekleşmez.

test_cases.title: Geçersiz karakter seti içeren girdinin reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistem çalışır durumda ve kullanıcı giriş ekranı erişilebilir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçersiz karakterler içeren bir metin (ör. SQL enjeksiyonu denemesi veya kontrol karakterleri).

steps.action: Sisteme, tanımlı karakter seti dışındaki karakterler içeren bir girdi gönderilir.
steps.expected: Sistem girdiyi reddeder ve kullanıcıya genel bir hata mesajı gösterir.

steps.action: Sistemin iz kayıtları kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Geçersiz girdi denemesi ve reddedilme işlemi iz kayıtlarına işlenir.

test_cases.title: Uzunluk sınırını aşan girdinin reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistem çalışır durumda ve ilgili alanın maksimum uzunluğu belirlenmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Maksimum uzunluğun bir karakter fazlası olan bir metin.
test_cases.assumptions: İlgili alanın maksimum karakter sınırı sistem dokümantasyonunda tanımlıdır.

steps.action: Sisteme, tanımlı maksimum uzunluğun bir karakter fazlası olan bir girdi gönderilir.
steps.expected: Sistem girdiyi reddeder ve kullanıcıya uzunluk hatası bildiren genel bir mesaj gösterir.

steps.action: Sistemin iz kayıtları kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Sınır aşımı denemesi iz kayıtlarına işlenir.

test_cases.title: Geçerli girdinin kabul edilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistem çalışır durumda.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tanımlı format, uzunluk ve karakter setine uygun geçerli bir girdi.

steps.action: Sisteme, tüm geçerlilik kurallarına uygun bir girdi gönderilir.
steps.expected: Sistem girdiyi kabul eder ve işlemi başarıyla tamamlar.

test_cases.title: Hata mesajının istismar edilebilir bilgi içermemesi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistem çalışır durumda ve bir hata durumu tetiklenebilir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sistem hatası tetikleyecek geçersiz bir girdi.

steps.action: Sisteme, bir hata durumuna neden olacak geçersiz bir girdi gönderilir.
steps.expected: Kullanıcıya, sistem yapısı, veritabanı şeması veya kod detayları içermeyen genel bir hata mesajı gösterilir.

steps.action: Hata mesajının içeriği incelenir.
steps.expected: Mesajda stack trace, SQL sorgusu, dosya yolu veya diğer teknik detaylar bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: Ayrıntılı hata bilgisinin yetkili personele gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistem çalışır durumda ve iz kayıtlarına erişim yetkisi olan bir test hesabı vardır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sistem hatası tetikleyecek geçersiz bir girdi.
test_cases.assumptions: İz kayıtlarına erişim yetkisi olan bir kullanıcı rolü tanımlıdır.

steps.action: Sisteme, bir hata durumuna neden olacak geçersiz bir girdi gönderilir.
steps.expected: Sistem hatası oluşur.

steps.action: İz kayıtlarına erişim yetkisi olan kullanıcı ile sisteme giriş yapılır ve hata kayıtları incelenir.
steps.expected: Yetkili kullanıcı, hata detaylarını (stack trace, hata kodu, girdi değeri vb.) iz kayıtlarında görebilir.

test_cases.title: Oturum süresi dolmadan önce yeniden doğrulama uyarısı ve taslak kaydı
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı aktif bir oturumda ve başvuru formunun ortasında bir adımda.
test_cases.assumptions: §14'te belirlenen uyarı süresi 5 dakika, toplam oturum süresi 30 dakika kabul edilmiştir.

steps.action: Oturum süresinin bitmesine 5 dakika kala kullanıcı formda veri girer.
steps.expected: Sistem, yeniden doğrulama uyarısı gösterir ve girilen veriyi taslak olarak kaydeder.

steps.action: Kullanıcı uyarıdaki 'Yeniden Doğrula' düğmesine tıklar ve kimlik doğrulamasını tamamlar.
steps.expected: Oturum uzatılır, kullanıcı veri kaybı olmadan kaldığı adıma döner.

test_cases.title: Oturum uzatma düğmesinin bulunmaması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı aktif bir oturumda.

steps.action: Kullanıcı arayüzde oturum süresini uzatmaya yönelik bir düğme veya menü öğesi arar.
steps.expected: Arayüzde oturum süresini manuel olarak uzatan bir düğme veya seçenek bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: Metin tabanlı CAPTCHA kullanılmaması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı kimlik doğrulama sayfasındadır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı kimlik doğrulama formunu açar ve sayfayı tarar.
steps.expected: Sayfada metin tabanlı CAPTCHA (ör. bozuk harf okuma) bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: Bot eşiği aşıldığında etkileşimsiz kanıt ve nesne tanıma sorgusu
test_cases.preconditions: Sistem bot doğrulama eşiğini aşacak şekilde yapılandırılmış veya simüle edilmiş bir istek akışı vardır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bot eşiğini aşan istek sayısı.
test_cases.assumptions: §14'teki bot eşiği 5 istek kabul edilmiştir.

steps.action: Bot eşiğini aşan istekler gönderilir.
steps.expected: Sistem önce etkileşimsiz tarayıcı kanıtı ister.

steps.action: Etkileşimsiz kanıt sağlanamazsa sistem bir sonraki adımı tetikler.
steps.expected: Sistem, WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.8 nesne tanıma istisnasına giren bir sorgu (ör. görsel nesne seçimi) gösterir.

test_cases.title: Ödeme sonucunun imzası doğrulanan bildirimle kabulü
test_cases.preconditions: Başvuru 'ödeme bekliyor' durumunda ve KÖA ile bağlantı kurulabilir.
test_cases.test_inputs: İmzası geçerli KÖA sunucu bildirimi.

steps.action: KÖA'dan imzası doğrulanan başarılı ödeme bildirimi gönderilir.
steps.expected: Başvuru durumu 'ödendi' olarak güncellenir.

test_cases.title: KÖA erişilemezse başvurunun 'ödeme bekliyor' durumunda kalması
test_cases.preconditions: Başvuru 'ödeme bekliyor' durumunda.
test_cases.test_inputs: KÖA erişim hatası simülasyonu.
test_cases.assumptions: §14'teki ödeme bekleme süresi 72 saat, sorgulama aralığı 15 dakika kabul edilmiştir.

steps.action: KÖA erişimi kesilir ve sistem ödeme sonucunu sorgular.
steps.expected: Başvuru durumu 'ödendi' yapılmaz, 'ödeme bekliyor' durumunda kalır.

steps.action: Sistem 15 dakika sonra tekrar sorgulama yapar.
steps.expected: Sistem belirsiz işlemi tekrar sorgular ve durum değişmedikçe 'ödeme bekliyor' olarak kalır.

test_cases.title: AAL2 altı doğrulama düzeyinde sınırlı kip açılması
test_cases.preconditions: e-Devlet'ten gelen kimlik belirteci AAL1 düzeyinde veya doğrulama alanları eksik.
test_cases.test_inputs: AAL1 düzeyinde e-Devlet belirteci.

steps.action: Kullanıcı AAL1 düzeyinde e-Devlet belirteciyle giriş yapar.
steps.expected: Oturum sınırlı kipte açılır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı kişisel veri veya başvuru içeriği görüntülemeye çalışır.
steps.expected: Kişisel veri ve başvuru içeriği gösterilmez.

steps.action: Arayüzü incelenir.
steps.expected: Kullanıcıya daha güçlü bir yöntemle yeniden giriş önerisi gösterilir.

test_cases.title: Şirket temsilcisi parola geçerlilik süresi bildirimi
test_cases.preconditions: Şirket temsilcisi hesabı VBP tarafından doğrulanmıştır ve parola süresi dolmak üzeredir.
test_cases.assumptions: §14'teki bildirim süresi 7 gün önce kabul edilmiştir.

steps.action: Parola geçerlilik süresinin dolmasına 7 gün kala sistem kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Kullanıcıya parola değişikliği bildirimi gönderilir.

test_cases.title: Sızıntı eşleşmesinde zorunlu parola değişikliği
test_cases.preconditions: Şirket temsilcisi hesabı VBP tarafından doğrulanmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sızıntı veritabanında bulunan parola.

steps.action: Kullanıcı sızıntı veritabanında bulunan bir parolayla giriş yapar.
steps.expected: Giriş kabul edilir ancak sistem parola değişikliğini süreyi beklemeden zorunlu kılar.

test_cases.title: TOTP geçerli ve bir önceki adım kodunun kabulü
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı TOTP doğrulaması yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli TOTP kodu, bir önceki adımın TOTP kodu.
test_cases.assumptions: §14'teki adım süresi 30 saniye kabul edilmiştir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı geçerli TOTP adımının kodunu girer.
steps.expected: Doğrulama başarılı olur.

steps.action: Yeni bir oturumda bir önceki adımın TOTP kodu girilir.
steps.expected: Doğrulama başarılı olur.

test_cases.title: TOTP eski ve ileri adım kodlarının reddi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı TOTP doğrulaması yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: İki adım öncesinin TOTP kodu, bir adım sonrasının TOTP kodu.
test_cases.assumptions: §14'teki adım süresi 30 saniye kabul edilmiştir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı iki adım öncesinin TOTP kodunu girer.
steps.expected: Doğrulama reddedilir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı bir adım sonrasının TOTP kodunu girer.
steps.expected: Doğrulama reddedilir.

test_cases.title: TOTP kodunun yalnızca bir kez kabulü
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı TOTP doğrulaması yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Aynı geçerli TOTP kodu.

steps.action: Kullanıcı geçerli TOTP kodunu girer ve doğrulama başarılı olur.
steps.expected: Doğrulama başarılı olur.

steps.action: Aynı TOTP kodu tekrar girilir.
steps.expected: Doğrulama reddedilir.

test_cases.title: Başarısız deneme eşiğinde doğrulayıcının devre dışı bırakılması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı hesabı aktif ve doğrulayıcılar etkin.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yanlış parola ve yanlış ikinci faktör kodu.
test_cases.assumptions: §14'teki devre dışı bırakma eşiği 5 deneme kabul edilmiştir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı 5 kez yanlış parola ve yanlış ikinci faktör koduyla giriş denemesi yapar.
steps.expected: Doğrulayıcılar (parola ve ikinci faktör) devre dışı bırakılır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı hesap kurtarma sürecini başlatır.
steps.expected: Yalnızca hesap kurtarma yoluyla yeniden bağlanma izni verilir.

test_cases.title: Başarılı girişte doğrulayıcı sayaçlarının sıfırlanması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı 3 başarısız deneme yapmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Doğru parola ve doğru ikinci faktör kodu.

steps.action: Kullanıcı doğru parola ve ikinci faktör koduyla giriş yapar.
steps.expected: Giriş başarılı olur ve başarısız deneme sayaçları sıfırlanır.

test_cases.title: AAL2 şirket temsilcisi hareketsizlik sonrası parola ile devam
test_cases.preconditions: Şirket temsilcisi AAL2 oturumunda ve hareketsizlik süresi dolmuş, toplam süre dolmamış.
test_cases.test_inputs: Doğru parola.

steps.action: Kullanıcı hareketsizlik süresi dolduktan sonra sayfaya döner.
steps.expected: Sistem yalnızca parola girmesini ister.

steps.action: Kullanıcı doğru parolayı girer.
steps.expected: Oturum devam eder.

test_cases.title: AAL2 vatandaş hareketsizlik sonrası e-Devlet yönlendirmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Vatandaş AAL2 oturumunda ve hareketsizlik süresi dolmuş, toplam süre dolmamış.

steps.action: Kullanıcı hareketsizlik süresi dolduktan sonra sayfaya döner.
steps.expected: Sistem kullanıcıyı e-Devlet'te taze doğrulamaya yönlendirir.

test_cases.title: AAL3 personel hareketsizlik sonrası oturum sırrının silinmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Personel AAL3 oturumunda ve hareketsizlik süresi dolmuş.

steps.action: Hareketsizlik süresi dolunca sunucu tarafı oturum kaydı incelenir.
steps.expected: Oturum sırrı sunucudan hemen silinmiştir.

test_cases.title: Vatandaş eşzamanlı oturum sınırının aşılması
test_cases.preconditions: Vatandaşın 3 aktif oturumu vardır.
test_cases.assumptions: §14'teki eşzamanlı oturum sınırı 3 kabul edilmiştir.

steps.action: Vatandaş 4. oturumu açar.
steps.expected: En eski oturum sonlandırılır ve kullanıcıya bildirim gösterilir.

test_cases.title: Personel eşzamanlı oturum sınırının aşılması ve SIEM bildirimi
test_cases.preconditions: Personelin 1 aktif oturumu vardır.
test_cases.assumptions: §14'teki personel eşzamanlı oturum sınırı 1 kabul edilmiştir.

steps.action: Personel 2. oturumu açar.
steps.expected: Oturum sınır aşımı olayı SIEM'e iletilir.

test_cases.title: İzin verilen dosya türünün kabulü
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı başvuru formunda dosya yükleme adımındadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: İzin verilen türde (ör. PDF) ve boyutta dosya.
test_cases.assumptions: §14'te PDF türü izinli kabul edilmiştir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı izin verilen türde ve boyutta bir dosya yükler.
steps.expected: Dosya kabul edilir.

test_cases.title: Uzantı ve içerik imzası uyuşmazlığında ret
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı başvuru formunda dosya yükleme adımındadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Uzantısı PDF ama içeriği EXE olan dosya.

steps.action: Kullanıcı uzantısı PDF ama içeriği EXE olan bir dosya yükler.
steps.expected: Dosya reddedilir ve ret nedeni dosya adıyla birlikte metin olarak bildirilir.

test_cases.title: Dosya boyut sınırının aşılması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı başvuru formunda dosya yükleme adımındadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: §14'teki boyut sınırını aşan dosya.
test_cases.assumptions: §14'teki dosya boyut sınırı 10 MB kabul edilmiştir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı 10 MB'dan büyük bir dosya yükler.
steps.expected: Dosya reddedilir ve ret nedeni dosya adıyla birlikte metin olarak bildirilir.

test_cases.title: Start of Mission tetikleyicisi ile oturum kurulumu (Level 2)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU Level 2 modunda yapılandırılmıştır. Start of Mission (SoM) prosedürü başlatılabilir durumda.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC ile iletişim kurmak için gerekli ağ altyapısı mevcuttur.

steps.action: Start of Mission prosedürü başlatılır.

test_cases.title: OBU does not open duplicate session with same RBC during establishment

steps.action: Initiate Start of Mission in Level 2 to trigger session establishment with RBC-A.

steps.action: While the session with RBC-A is still being established, trigger a second request to connect to RBC-A (e.g., via a new trackside order or driver action).
steps.expected: OBU does not initiate a new, separate communication session establishment process with RBC-A. The existing establishment process continues or is handled according to single-session logic, but no duplicate session is opened.

test_cases.title: OBU does not open duplicate session with same RBC when session is active

steps.action: Verify that a communication session with RBC-A is active and stable.
steps.expected: OBU status indicates an active session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Trigger a condition that would normally cause a session establishment with RBC-A (e.g., driver manually selects RBC contact information for RBC-A outside Start of Mission).
steps.expected: OBU does not attempt to open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing session remains active.

test_cases.title: OBU terminates existing session to establish new one with different RBC

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to establish a communication session with RBC-B.

steps.action: Wait for the termination of the session with RBC-A to complete.
steps.expected: OBU sends the Termination of Communication Session message to RBC-A and releases the GSM-R connection.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action towards RBC-B.
steps.expected: OBU initiates the establishment of a new communication session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: OBU maintains session with supervising RBC during RBC transition to Accepting RBC

test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order containing an embedded order to establish a session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order from RBC-A that includes an embedded order to establish a session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).
steps.expected: OBU does not terminate the existing session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action towards RBC-B.
steps.expected: OBU initiates the establishment of a new communication session with RBC-B while maintaining the session with RBC-A.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates balise info validity based on crossing direction in SL mode
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Sleeping (SL) mode. Train orientation is set to 'Forward'. A balise group is located ahead in the 'Reverse' direction relative to the train orientation (i.e., the train is moving backwards or the balise is behind in the forward orientation context, but the crossing direction is defined by the physical movement). Let's clarify: Train orientation is Forward. Balise is crossed in Reverse direction (train moving backwards).
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group containing information valid only for 'Reverse' direction. Balise group containing information valid only for 'Forward' direction.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can detect the direction of crossing of the balise group.

steps.action: Set engine to Sleeping (SL) mode. Orient train to 'Forward'.
steps.expected: OBU is in SL mode with Forward orientation.

steps.action: Cross a balise group in the 'Reverse' direction (train moves backwards). The balise contains information valid only for 'Reverse' direction.
steps.expected: OBU takes the information into account because it is valid for the crossing direction.

steps.action: Cross another balise group in the 'Reverse' direction. The balise contains information valid only for 'Forward' direction.
steps.expected: OBU ignores the information because it is valid only for the opposite direction (Forward) relative to the crossing direction (Reverse).

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates balise info validity based on crossing direction in PS mode
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Passive Shunting (PS) mode. Train orientation is set to 'Forward'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group containing information valid for 'Both' directions.

steps.action: Set engine to Passive Shunting (PS) mode. Orient train to 'Forward'.
steps.expected: OBU is in PS mode with Forward orientation.

steps.action: Cross a balise group in the 'Forward' direction. The balise contains information valid for 'Both' directions.
steps.expected: OBU takes the information into account because it is valid for both directions.

test_cases.title: OBU keeps applying last MA request parameters until new ones received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 and has received MA request parameters from RBC (e.g., repetition period = 10s).

steps.action: Receive MA request parameters from RBC with a repetition period of 10 seconds.
steps.expected: OBU stores the parameters.

steps.action: Wait for 10 seconds to elapse since the last MA request.
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request according to the 10-second repetition period.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from RBC with a repetition period of 5 seconds.
steps.expected: OBU replaces the old parameters with the new ones immediately.

test_cases.title: OBU sends immediate MA request if time since last request >= new repetition period
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. Last MA request was sent 10 seconds ago. Current MA request parameters have a repetition period of 10 seconds.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters received with a repetition period of 10 seconds.

steps.action: Ensure the time since the last MA request is exactly 10 seconds (equal to the current repetition period).
steps.expected: OBU is ready to send an MA request based on the current parameters.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from RBC with a repetition period of 10 seconds.
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request immediately upon receiving the new parameters, because the time since the last request (10s) is equal to the newly received repetition period (10s).

test_cases.title: OBU keeps Level 1 signalling speed restriction valid until new one received

steps.expected: A new safe radio connection is established, and the communication session is maintained.

test_cases.title: Repeated reconnection attempts until success
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated radio interference causing initial reconnection failures, followed by restored signal.
test_cases.assumptions: The session termination timer has not expired, and the train has not passed the RIU termination location.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts attempting to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate a failure in the first reconnection attempt (e.g., no response from trackside).
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the attempt to set up the safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate a failure in the second reconnection attempt.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the attempt to set up the safe radio connection again.

steps.action: Restore radio signal quality to allow successful connection.
steps.expected: The OBU successfully establishes the safe radio connection and stops repeating the attempts.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when session is terminated by timeout
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated persistent radio loss exceeding the defined session maintenance time.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined time for considering the session terminated is known and configurable or observable in the test environment.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts attempting to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Maintain the radio loss condition until the defined time for session maintenance expires.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session as terminated.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's reconnection behavior after the session is considered terminated.
steps.expected: The OBU stops the specific reconnection attempts for the terminated session (as per 3.5.4.3, attempts stop when session is considered terminated). Note: Per 3.5.4.3.1, new attempts may resume for a new session, but the loop for the *current* lost session stops.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is lost. An RIU order to terminate the communication session at a specific location is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated radio loss. Train movement data indicating passage of the RIU termination location.
test_cases.assumptions: The RIU termination location is ahead of the train's current position.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts attempting to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate the train passing the location indicated in the RIU order to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU stops the attempts to set up a new safe radio connection for this session.

test_cases.title: OBU initiates session termination upon explicit trackside order

steps.action: Send a 'Termination of communication session' order from the RBC to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a 'Termination of communication session' message to the RBC.

steps.action: Monitor OBU radio traffic for a duration longer than the fixed waiting time.
steps.expected: No further messages are sent by the OBU.

test_cases.title: OBU does not initiate session termination without valid trigger

steps.action: Monitor OBU radio traffic for a duration significantly longer than the fixed waiting time without sending any trackside orders or triggering termination conditions.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send a 'Termination of communication session' message.

test_cases.title: OBU repeats termination message when acknowledgement is missing
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. The OBU has initiated termination (e.g., via trackside order).
test_cases.test_inputs: The RBC does not send an 'Acknowledgement of termination of communication session' message.
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time is known and configurable for the test environment.

steps.action: Trigger the OBU to send the first 'Termination of communication session' message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends the 'Termination of communication session' message.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time to elapse without sending an acknowledgement from the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a second 'Termination of communication session' message.

test_cases.title: OBU considers session terminated after max repetitions without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in the process of terminating a session and has already repeated the termination message the defined number of times minus one.
test_cases.test_inputs: The RBC does not send an acknowledgement for the final repetition.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined number of repetitions is known (e.g., N). The test simulates N-1 successful repetitions followed by the Nth repetition.

steps.action: Allow the OBU to send the final (Nth) 'Termination of communication session' message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends the Nth 'Termination of communication session' message.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time to elapse after the Nth message without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU internally marks the communication session as terminated.

steps.action: Attempt to send a new message requiring an active session (e.g., a position report) or check the session status indicator.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send the message or indicates that no active session exists.

steps.expected: OBU rejects the message or flags it as invalid because the reference balise group is outside the accepted window of the last 8 reported LRBGs.

steps.expected: The OBU processes the data packet and updates its internal state accordingly.

test_cases.title: OBU rejects one-direction data when orientation is unknown

steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data packet.

steps.action: Transmit a data packet valid for both directions to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates and accepts the data packet.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data interpretation: standard incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has previously received profile data. The train is moving in the nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile data structure with values V1, V2, V3 and incremental distances D1, D2, D3.
test_cases.assumptions: Previously received data is 'PrevData'.

steps.action: Transmit continuous profile data with values [V1, V2, V3] and distances [D1, D2, D3].
steps.expected: The OBU applies 'PrevData' for the first distance segment (0 to D1). It applies V1 for the segment D1 to D1+D2. It applies V2 for the segment D1+D2 to D1+D2+D3. It applies V3 for the distance beyond D1+D2+D3.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data interpretation: zero distance increment
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has previously received profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile data structure where the second incremental distance is 0.

steps.action: Transmit continuous profile data with values [V1, V2] and distances [D1, 0].
steps.expected: The OBU takes V2 into account. The value V2 is applied immediately after V1, effectively overriding V1 at the same location or for the subsequent segment, as per the rule that a value followed by zero distance is still taken into account.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data interpretation: end-of-profile value
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has previously received profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile data structure ending with a special 'end of profile' value.

steps.action: Transmit continuous profile data where the last value is the special 'end of profile' marker.
steps.expected: The OBU does not apply the last value for an unlimited distance. The profile data ends at the specified distance.

test_cases.title: Location data interpretation: unsigned incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has previously received location data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location data with values L1, L2 and incremental distances D1, D2.
test_cases.assumptions: Previously received location data is 'PrevLoc'.

steps.action: Transmit location data with values [L1, L2] and distances [D1, D2].
steps.expected: The OBU uses 'PrevLoc' for the first distance segment (0 to D1). It uses L1 for the segment D1 to D1+D2. It uses L2 for the distance beyond D1+D2. The distances are treated as unsigned increments.

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile data interpretation: overlapping elements
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has previously received non-continuous profile data or default values.
test_cases.test_inputs: Non-continuous profile data with two elements. Element 1: Value V1, Length Len1. Element 2: Value V2, Length Len2. Incremental distance to start of Element 2 is D2, where D2 < Len1 (causing overlap).

steps.action: Transmit non-continuous profile data where the start of the second element is closer than the length of the first element (overlap).
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the data. It interprets the start of Element 2 as being at distance D2 from the start of Element 1. It does not reject the data due to the overlap.

test_cases.title: Linking information interpretation: distances to balise groups
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state to process linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information with values Link1, Link2 and distances D1, D2.

steps.action: Transmit linking information with values [Link1, Link2] and distances [D1, D2].
steps.expected: The OBU interprets D1 as the distance to the first announced balise group (associated with Link1). It interprets D2 as the distance between the first and second announced balise groups (associated with Link2).

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking consistency is checked.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information containing location accuracy for Balise Group A. Balise Group A is received.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking information provides a specific location accuracy value (e.g., 10m) for Balise Group A.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group A and associated linking information specifying its location accuracy.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the location accuracy of Balise Group A as the value provided in the linking information.

steps.action: Query the internal state of the OBU for the location accuracy of Balise Group A.
steps.expected: The reported location accuracy matches the value from the linking information.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from National Value when linking is unavailable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking consistency is checked. No linking information with location accuracy is available for Balise Group B.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise Group B is received and becomes LRBG. National Value for location accuracy is configured (e.g., 20m).
test_cases.assumptions: The National Value for location accuracy is applicable and defined in the OBU configuration.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group B which becomes the LRBG without prior linking information determining its location accuracy.
steps.expected: The OBU determines the location accuracy of Balise Group B using the applicable National Value.

steps.action: Query the internal state of the OBU for the location accuracy of Balise Group B.
steps.expected: The reported location accuracy matches the configured National Value.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from Default Value when National Value is not applicable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking consistency is checked. No linking information with location accuracy is available for Balise Group C. National Value is not applicable.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise Group C is received and becomes LRBG. Default Value for location accuracy is configured (e.g., 30m).
test_cases.assumptions: The National Value is not applicable for this location, and the Default Value is defined in the OBU configuration.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group C which becomes the LRBG without prior linking information determining its location accuracy.
steps.expected: The OBU determines the location accuracy of Balise Group C using the Default Value.

steps.action: Query the internal state of the OBU for the location accuracy of Balise Group C.
steps.expected: The reported location accuracy matches the configured Default Value.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated upon further linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined the location accuracy of Balise Group A from initial linking information (e.g., 10m).
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information is received that specifies a different location accuracy for Balise Group A (e.g., 15m).
test_cases.assumptions: The initial location accuracy was determined according to §3.6.4.1.3.

steps.action: Receive new linking information containing a different location accuracy value for Balise Group A.
steps.expected: The OBU does not update the stored location accuracy of Balise Group A.

steps.action: Query the internal state of the OBU for the location accuracy of Balise Group A.
steps.expected: The reported location accuracy remains the initial value (10m).

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated when linking is no longer checked
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined the location accuracy of Balise Group A (e.g., 10m). Linking consistency is currently checked.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking consistency check is disabled. New National Values become applicable.
test_cases.assumptions: The initial location accuracy was determined according to §3.6.4.1.3.

steps.action: Disable the linking consistency check in the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to use the previously determined location accuracy for Balise Group A.

steps.action: Query the internal state of the OBU for the location accuracy of Balise Group A.
steps.expected: The reported location accuracy remains the initial value (10m).

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated when new National Values become applicable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined the location accuracy of Balise Group A using a National Value (e.g., 20m).
test_cases.test_inputs: New National Values are loaded into the OBU configuration.
test_cases.assumptions: The initial location accuracy was determined according to §3.6.4.1.3.

steps.action: Update the OBU configuration with new National Values for location accuracy.
steps.expected: The OBU does not update the stored location accuracy of Balise Group A.

steps.action: Query the internal state of the OBU for the location accuracy of Balise Group A.
steps.expected: The reported location accuracy remains the initial value (20m).

test_cases.title: Confidence interval delimitation with min and max safe front ends
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Train is moving. Reference balise group (LRBG) has a known location accuracy (e.g., 10m). Over-reading amount is 5m, under-reading amount is 5m. No consist-length-related situation applies.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated front end position is 1000m from LRBG.
test_cases.assumptions: The over-reading and under-reading amounts are constant for this test.

steps.action: Set the estimated front end position to 1000m from the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the min safe front end position as 1000m - 10m (location accuracy) - 5m (under-reading) = 985m.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the max safe front end position.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the max safe front end position as 1000m + 10m (location accuracy) + 5m (over-reading) = 1015m.

steps.action: Verify the confidence interval boundaries.
steps.expected: The min safe front end is in rear of the estimated front end, and the max safe front end is in advance of the estimated front end.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is checked
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking consistency is checked.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise Group A is received and is the reference of linking information. Balise Group B is received later and is announced in linking information.
test_cases.assumptions: Both Balise Group A and B are valid for SOLR selection.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group A which is the reference of linking information.
steps.expected: The OBU sets Balise Group A as the SOLR.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group B which is announced in linking information.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the SOLR to Balise Group B, as it is the most recently received balise group that is either the reference of or announced in linking information.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is not checked
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking consistency is not checked.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise Group A is received. Balise Group B is received later.
test_cases.assumptions: No linking information is processed.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group A.
steps.expected: The OBU sets Balise Group A as the SOLR.

steps.action: Receive Balise Group B.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the SOLR to Balise Group B, as it is the last received balise group.

test_cases.title: Linking replacement rule applied before SOLR update
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking consistency is checked. Current SOLR is Balise Group A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information is received that references Balise Group B as the new SOLR.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking replacement rule of §3.7.3.1 m) is defined and applicable.

steps.action: Receive linking information that implies a change in SOLR to Balise Group B.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the linking replacement rule before updating the SOLR.

steps.action: Verify the SOLR after processing.
steps.expected: The SOLR is updated to Balise Group B, and the linking replacement rule has been applied as per §3.7.3.1 m).

test_cases.title: Processing location based information into min, estimated, and max items
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location based information is received that requires processing into min, estimated, and max location items.
test_cases.assumptions: The information type is associated with a clause in SUBSET-026 Table 2a that specifies the use of min, estimated, or max items.

steps.action: Receive location based information that requires processing into min, estimated, and max items.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the information into up to three location items: min, estimated, and max.

steps.action: Verify the application of the corresponding clause for each location item.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the clause associated with each location item type as per SUBSET-026 Table 2a.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items to SOLR using linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Current SOLR is Balise Group A. A location item is referred to Balise Group B (FRBG). Linking information provides the distance between Balise Group B and Balise Group A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Distance from location item to Balise Group B is 500m. Distance between Balise Group B and Balise Group A is 100m (from linking information).
test_cases.assumptions: The linking information is available and known, and no repositioning balise group is encountered between Balise Group B and Balise Group A.

steps.action: Evaluate the location item referred to Balise Group B while the SOLR is Balise Group A.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the location item to the SOLR by subtracting the distance between Balise Group B and Balise Group A (100m) from the distance to Balise Group B (500m).

steps.action: Verify the relocated distance of the location item.
steps.expected: The relocated distance is 400m from the SOLR (Balise Group A).

test_cases.title: Relocation of min location item with location accuracy adjustment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Current SOLR is Balise Group A. A min location item is referred to Balise Group B (FRBG). The last relocation was performed as per clause 3.6.4.2.5 c) towards a BG not received earlier than the reference BG. Linking information provides the distance between Balise Group B and Balise Group A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Distance from min location item to Balise Group B is 500m. Distance between Balise Group B and Balise Group A is 100m (from linking information). Location accuracy of Balise Group B is 10m.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking information is available and known, and no repositioning balise group is encountered between Balise Group B and Balise Group A.

steps.action: Evaluate the min location item referred to Balise Group B while the SOLR is Balise Group A.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the min location item to the SOLR by subtracting the distance between Balise Group B and Balise Group A (100m) and twice the location accuracy of Balise Group B (20m) from the distance to Balise Group B (500m).

steps.action: Verify the relocated distance of the min location item.
steps.expected: The relocated distance is 380m from the SOLR (Balise Group A).

test_cases.title: Relocation of max location item with location accuracy adjustment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Current SOLR is Balise Group A. A max location item is referred to Balise Group B (FRBG). The last relocation was performed as per clause 3.6.4.2.5 c) towards a BG not received earlier than the reference BG. Linking information provides the distance between Balise Group B and Balise Group A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Distance from max location item to Balise Group B is 500m. Distance between Balise Group B and Balise Group A is 100m (from linking information). Location accuracy of Balise Group B is 10m.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking information is available and known, and no repositioning balise group is encountered between Balise Group B and Balise Group A.

steps.action: Evaluate the max location item referred to Balise Group B while the SOLR is Balise Group A.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the max location item to the SOLR by subtracting the distance between Balise Group B and Balise Group A (100m) and adding twice the location accuracy of Balise Group B (20m) to the distance to Balise Group B (500m).

steps.action: Verify the relocated distance of the max location item.
steps.expected: The relocated distance is 420m from the SOLR (Balise Group A).

test_cases.title: Position report on reaching standstill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode allowing movement (e.g., Full Supervision) and connected to RBC. Train is moving.

steps.action: Decelerate the train until it reaches standstill (speed = 0).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report on leaving standstill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC. Train is at standstill.

steps.action: Accelerate the train from standstill to a speed greater than 0.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report on mode change
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode and connected to RBC.

steps.action: Trigger a mode change (e.g., to Shunting or Standby) via driver action or system event.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report on level change
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 and connected to RBC.

steps.action: Trigger a level change (e.g., to Level 1 or NTC) via driver action or system event.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report on driver integrity confirmation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC. Train integrity status is 'No integrity information' or 'Lost'.

steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity via the DMI.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report on loss of train integrity
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC. Train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver' or 'Confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: Simulate a loss of train integrity (e.g., via external sensor or test command).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report on RBC/RBC border crossing (min safe rear end)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC A. Train is approaching the border with RBC B.

steps.action: Move the train such that its minimum safe rear end crosses the RBC/RBC border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report on RBC/RBC border crossing (max safe front end)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC A. Train is approaching the border with RBC B.

steps.action: Move the train such that its maximum safe front end crosses the RBC/RBC border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report on successful session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is not connected to an RBC.

steps.action: Establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report on passing LRBG compliant balise group without stored parameters
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC. No position report parameters are stored on-board.

steps.action: Pass an LRBG compliant balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report on error detection
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC.

steps.action: Trigger an error as defined in SUBSET-026 §3.16.4.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Report train integrity status 'No integrity information'
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC. Train integrity status is 'No integrity information'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The position report contains train integrity status 'No integrity information' and does not contain a confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Report train integrity status 'Confirmed by driver' with length
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC. Train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver'. Valid train length is available.

steps.action: Trigger a position report (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The position report contains train integrity status 'Confirmed by driver' and the confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Report train integrity status 'Confirmed by external source' with length
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC. Train integrity status is 'Confirmed by external source'. Valid train length is available.

steps.action: Trigger a position report (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The position report contains train integrity status 'Confirmed by external source' and the confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Report train integrity status 'Lost' without length
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC. Train integrity status is 'Lost'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The position report contains train integrity status 'Lost' and does not contain a confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'No integrity information' to 'Confirmed by driver'
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC. Train integrity status is 'No integrity information'.

steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Confirmed by driver'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Confirmed by driver' to 'Lost'
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC. Train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: Simulate a loss of train integrity.
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Lost'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Lost' to 'No integrity information'
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC. Train integrity status is 'Lost'.

steps.action: Trigger a condition that resets integrity status to 'No integrity information' (e.g., new session establishment or specific reset per Table 2c).
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'No integrity information'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Confirmed by external source' to 'Lost'
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is connected to RBC. Train integrity status is 'Confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: Simulate a loss of train integrity.
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Lost'.

test_cases.title: Geographical position display on driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where geographical position information is available and valid. The geographical position display is currently inactive.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver request to display geographical position.

steps.action: Verify that the geographical position is not displayed on the HMI.
steps.expected: The geographical position is not visible on the driver display.

steps.action: The driver issues a request to display the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the geographical position of the estimated front end of the train in relation to the track kilometre.

test_cases.title: Stop geographical position display on driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The geographical position is currently being displayed on the HMI.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver request to stop displaying geographical position.

steps.action: Verify that the geographical position is currently displayed.
steps.expected: The geographical position is visible on the driver display.

steps.action: The driver issues a request to stop the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the geographical position. The position information is no longer visible on the driver display.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation includes distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has received valid geographical position information from a balise group. The train is moving in the direction of the track kilometre counting direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement data (odometer/speed) indicating a specific distance travelled from the reference balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The offset from the reference balise group to the track kilometre reference is known and stored. The counting direction is consistent with the train's movement.

steps.action: Record the initial geographical position displayed or calculated by the OBU immediately after passing the reference balise group (distance travelled = 0).
steps.expected: The displayed/calculated position corresponds to the track kilometre reference value adjusted by the offset.

steps.action: Move the train a known distance (e.g., 100 meters) away from the reference balise group in the counting direction.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the new geographical position by adding the 100 meters travelled to the previous position.

steps.action: Request the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The displayed track kilometre value reflects the initial reference value plus the 100 meters travelled.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation with reverse counting direction
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has received valid geographical position information where the track kilometre counting direction is opposite to the train's movement direction (or the train is moving against the counting direction).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement data indicating distance travelled in the direction opposite to the track kilometre increment.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly interprets the 'counting direction' parameter from the geographical position information.

steps.action: Record the initial geographical position at the reference point.
steps.expected: The position is correctly initialized based on the reference and offset.

steps.action: Move the train a known distance (e.g., 50 meters) in the direction that decreases the track kilometre value (based on the defined counting direction).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the new geographical position by subtracting the 50 meters from the reference value (or adding the distance in the negative direction).

steps.action: Request the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The displayed track kilometre value reflects the correct calculation accounting for the counting direction and the distance travelled.

test_cases.title: Roll-away distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where Roll Away Protection supervision can be initiated (e.g., Standstill). The train is stationary at a known location not associated with a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: National/Default Value for Roll Away Protection distance (e.g., 10 m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a debug interface or log to observe the calculated 'remaining distance' and the 'estimated distance travelled'.

steps.action: Initiate the Roll Away Protection supervision function.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates and stores the remaining distance to be travelled as equal to the National/Default Value for Roll Away Protection (e.g., 10 m). The estimated distance travelled away from the start location is initialized to 0.

steps.action: Move the train forward by a known distance (e.g., 2 m) using a test rig or simulation.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the estimated distance travelled to 2 m. The remaining distance is calculated as 10 m - 2 m = 8 m.

test_cases.title: Post Trip reversing distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Post Trip mode. The train is stationary.
test_cases.test_inputs: National/Default Value for maximum distance for reversing in Post Trip mode (e.g., 5 m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows manual entry or configuration of the Post Trip reversing limit for testing purposes.

steps.action: Initiate the supervision for reversing in Post Trip mode.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance for reversing as equal to the configured National/Default Value (e.g., 5 m).

steps.action: Move the train in the reverse direction by 1 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the estimated distance travelled in the reverse direction to 1 m. The remaining distance for reversing is calculated as 5 m - 1 m = 4 m.

test_cases.title: Staff Responsible distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Staff Responsible (SR) mode. A valid SR distance is set (e.g., via RBC or driver input).
test_cases.test_inputs: SR distance value (e.g., 100 m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs the 'virtual train front position' parameters (estimated, min safe, max safe) and the calculated remaining distances.

steps.action: Enter Staff Responsible mode with a distance of 100 m.
steps.expected: The OBU initializes the virtual train front position. The remaining distance from the estimated front end to the end of the supervised distance is 100 m. The remaining distance from the max safe front end is 100 m (assuming 0 under-reading). The remaining distance from the min safe front end is 100 m (assuming 0 over-reading).

steps.action: Move the train forward by 10 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the estimated distance travelled to 10 m. The remaining distance from the estimated front end is 100 m - 10 m = 90 m.

test_cases.title: Standstill supervision distance calculation with movement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Standstill supervision mode. The standstill distance limit is defined (e.g., 1 m).
test_cases.test_inputs: Standstill distance limit (1 m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU monitors the 'estimated distance travelled' for standstill supervision.

steps.action: Initiate Standstill supervision.
steps.expected: The remaining distance for standstill supervision is initialized to the limit value (1 m).

steps.action: Move the train by 0.5 m.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is updated to 1 m - 0.5 m = 0.5 m. No safety reaction is triggered.

steps.action: Move the train by an additional 0.6 m (total 1.1 m).
steps.expected: The remaining distance becomes negative (1 m - 1.1 m = -0.1 m). The OBU triggers the appropriate safety reaction for exceeding the standstill distance.

test_cases.title: Virtual train position calculation with odometer under-reading
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Staff Responsible mode with a distance of 100 m. The odometer is configured to simulate an under-reading of 2 m since the supervision started.
test_cases.test_inputs: SR distance: 100 m. Odometer under-reading: 2 m. Actual movement: 10 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows injection of odometer error values for testing. The 'max safe front end position' is derived using the under-reading correction.

steps.action: Start SR supervision with 100 m distance.
steps.expected: Initial remaining distance from max safe front end is 100 m.

steps.action: Move the train 10 m, with the odometer under-reading accumulating to 2 m.
steps.expected: The estimated distance travelled is 10 m. The remaining distance from the max safe front end is calculated as: Supervised Distance (100) - Estimated Distance Travelled (10) - Odometer Under-reading (2) = 88 m.

test_cases.title: Virtual train position calculation with odometer over-reading
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Staff Responsible mode with a distance of 100 m. The odometer is configured to simulate an over-reading of 3 m since the supervision started.
test_cases.test_inputs: SR distance: 100 m. Odometer over-reading: 3 m. Actual movement: 10 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows injection of odometer error values for testing. The 'min safe front end position' is derived using the over-reading correction.

steps.action: Start SR supervision with 100 m distance.
steps.expected: Initial remaining distance from min safe front end is 100 m.

steps.action: Move the train 10 m, with the odometer over-reading accumulating to 3 m.
steps.expected: The estimated distance travelled is 10 m. The remaining distance from the min safe front end is calculated as: Supervised Distance (100) - Estimated Distance Travelled (10) + Odometer Over-reading (3) = 93 m.

test_cases.title: Supervision re-start after Override in SR mode
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Staff Responsible mode with a distance of 100 m. The train has moved 20 m.
test_cases.test_inputs: New SR distance: 50 m (updated via RBC or driver).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs the deletion of the previous virtual train position and the creation of a new one.

steps.action: Update the SR distance to 50 m while in SR mode.
steps.expected: The OBU deletes the previous virtual train position. A new virtual train position is created. The remaining distance from the estimated front end is reset to 50 m (the new supervised distance), regardless of the previous 20 m movement.

test_cases.title: Zero distance supervision after Override without valid position
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Selective Brake (SB) or Post Trip (PT) mode. No valid train position is stored on-board. The Override function is triggered.
test_cases.test_inputs: Override function activation.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs the supervision of the 'zero distance to the former EOA/LOA'.

steps.action: Trigger the Override function in SB mode without a valid stored train position.
steps.expected: The OBU starts supervision of a zero distance to the former EOA/LOA. The remaining distance is initialized to 0 m.

steps.action: Move the train by 0.1 m.
steps.expected: The OBU detects movement beyond the zero distance. The appropriate safety reaction (e.g., trip condition or de-activation of Override) is triggered as per the specific Override logic.

test_cases.title: MA kabul edilmemesi: SSP/gradient MA uzunluğunu tam kapsamıyor (Non-infill)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2'de çalışmaktadır. Mevcut MA ve SSP/gradient verileri yüklenmiştir. RBC, yeni bir MA göndermeye hazırdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni MA: EOA (Supervised Location) mevcut SSP/gradient verisinin bittiği noktadan ötede. SSP/gradient verisi, trenin tahmini ön ucundan EOA'ya kadar olan mesafeyi tam olarak kapsamamaktadır (kısa).
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin tahmini ön ucu (estimated front end) ve EOA konumu test ortamında kontrol edilebilir ve ayarlanabilir.

steps.action: RBC'den, SSP ve gradient verisinin MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (tahmini tren ön ucundan EOA'ya kadar) kapsamadığı bir MA gönderilir.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Route Suitability Loading Gauge Information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode and has stored route suitability loading gauge information for a specific route section.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new track description message containing updated route suitability loading gauge information.
test_cases.assumptions: The new information is valid and received via a valid balise or radio link.

steps.action: Transmit a new track description message containing new route suitability loading gauge information to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the message and replaces all previously stored route suitability loading gauge information with the new data.

steps.action: Query the OBU's internal state for route suitability loading gauge information.
steps.expected: The stored information matches the new data completely, and no old data remains.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Adhesion Factor Information from Start Location
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored adhesion factor information for a route section starting at location L1.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new track description message containing new adhesion factor information starting at location L2 (where L2 > L1).
test_cases.assumptions: Location L2 is within the range of the previously stored information.

steps.expected: The original stored information remains unchanged between L1 and L2.

steps.action: Query the OBU's internal state for adhesion factor information from L2 onwards.
steps.expected: The stored information from L2 onwards matches the new data.

steps.action: Query the OBU's internal state for linking information associated with BG_B.
steps.expected: The stored linking information for BG_B matches the new data.

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre with Same Validity Direction
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode with a current train orientation. The OBU has stored location-based information.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with a validity direction matching the current train orientation.
test_cases.assumptions: The authorisation is valid and the direction matches the train's current orientation.

steps.action: Transmit a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with a validity direction matching the current train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the normal replacement rules of SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1 to the new Movement Authority.

steps.action: Query the OBU's internal state for location-based information.
steps.expected: The location-based information is updated according to the normal replacement rules, not deleted.

steps.expected: All previously stored location-based information is deleted.

test_cases.title: MA request includes all applicable reasons
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with the RBC is established. The OBU is configured to send MA requests.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated conditions to trigger multiple MA request reasons simultaneously (e.g., driver selects 'Start' and a Section timer is about to expire).
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment allows monitoring of the MA request message content sent to the RBC.

steps.action: Configure the OBU such that two or more MA request reasons are applicable simultaneously (e.g., driver selects 'Start' and the time before a Section timer expires is reached).
steps.expected: The OBU prepares an MA request.

steps.action: Trigger the MA request transmission.
steps.expected: The MA request message sent to the RBC contains all applicable MA request reasons (e.g., 'Start selected by driver' and 'Time before a Section timer/LOA speed timer expires reached').

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by passing perturbation location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. MA request parameters for perturbation location are received from the RBC. The train is moving towards a defined perturbation location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed and position data simulating the train front passing the calculated perturbation location.
test_cases.assumptions: The perturbation location and warning speed are known and configured in the test scenario.

steps.action: Move the train such that the train front approaches the location defined by the perturbation-location criterion (time before reaching perturbation location at warning speed).
steps.expected: No MA request is sent yet.

steps.action: Continue moving the train until the train front passes the calculated perturbation location.
steps.expected: An MA request is triggered and sent to the RBC with the reason 'Time before reaching the perturbation location reached'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by Section timer criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. MA request parameters for Section timer are received from the RBC. A Section timer is active and supervised.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time simulation to reach the defined time before the Section timer expires.
test_cases.assumptions: The Section timer value and the defined time before expiration are known.

steps.action: Wait until the time before the Section timer expires reaches the defined triggering time criterion.
steps.expected: An MA request is triggered and sent to the RBC with the reason 'Time before a Section timer/LOA speed timer expires reached'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by track description deletion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A valid track description is present. A communication session with the RBC is established.
test_cases.test_inputs: A track description deletion event corresponding to a situation in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 (excluding a, b, f, k).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific situation in A.3.4 used for the test is one that requires an MA request (e.g., situation c, d, e, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p, q, r, s, t, u, v, w, x, y, z).

steps.action: Trigger a track description deletion event that falls under one of the applicable situations in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 (not a, b, f, or k).
steps.expected: An MA request is sent to the RBC with the reason 'Track description deletion'.

test_cases.title: No MA request for excluded track description deletion situations
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A valid track description is present. A communication session with the RBC is established.
test_cases.test_inputs: A track description deletion event corresponding to one of the excluded situations in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 (a, b, f, or k).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific situation in A.3.4 used for the test is one of the excluded situations (a, b, f, or k).

steps.action: Trigger a track description deletion event that falls under one of the excluded situations in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 (e.g., situation a).
steps.expected: No MA request is sent to the RBC with the reason 'Track description deletion'.

test_cases.title: End Section timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an End Section timer start location ahead of the train is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA containing End Section timer start location and time-out value.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving towards the End Section timer start location.

steps.action: Move the train so that its max safe front end passes the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts counting on-board.

test_cases.title: End Section timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: End Section timer is running. The train is moving within the End Section. The MA has a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority (LOA).
test_cases.test_inputs: Time-out value from trackside.
test_cases.assumptions: The train has not yet reached the End of Movement Authority.

steps.action: Wait until the End Section timer value exceeds the time-out value given by trackside.
steps.expected: The EOA/LOA is withdrawn to the current position of the train. Location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. The non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2. A new MA message is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA message with a specific time stamp.

steps.action: Receive the MA message in Level 2.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the value of the time stamp of the message containing the MA.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 1. The train is approaching a balise group that provides the MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group with MA information.

steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the moment of passage over the first encountered balise.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: LOA speed timer is running. The MA has a non-zero speed associated with the LOA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time-out value from trackside.

steps.action: Wait until the LOA speed timer value exceeds the time-out value received from trackside.
steps.expected: The speed associated with the LOA is set to zero. The LOA becomes an EOA. The Supervised Location is defined per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5. Location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an Overlap timer start location ahead of the train is received.

steps.action: Move the train so that its max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer starts counting on-board.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start with infinite time-out value
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an Overlap timer start location ahead of the train is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA containing Overlap timer start location and time-out value 'infinite'.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving towards the Overlap timer start location.

steps.action: Move the train so that its max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is considered as started on-board.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer is running. The MA includes an Overlap with a release speed and a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time-out value from trackside.

steps.action: Wait until the Overlap timer value exceeds the time-out value given by trackside.
steps.expected: The overlap information is deleted. The release speed associated with the Overlap is deleted. The Supervised Location is redetermined per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5. Location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. The non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiration upon train standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer has been started. The train is moving.
test_cases.assumptions: The train can be brought to a standstill.

steps.action: Bring the train to a standstill after the Overlap timer has been started.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the Overlap timer value as greater than its time-out value. The consequences defined for Overlap time-out in SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.4.2 are applied (overlap deleted, release speed deleted, SvL redetermined, target speed at EOA set to zero).

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiration upon receiving new MA with rear start location

steps.action: Receive the new MA with the Overlap timer start location in rear of the max safe front end.
steps.expected: The OBU considers that the Overlap timer value has exceeded its time-out value. The consequences defined in SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.4.2 are applied.

steps.expected: The Supervised Location is the end of the End Section.

test_cases.title: Partial replacement of MA data from Infill Information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a valid MA. The train is approaching a balise group that transmits infill information for the next main signal.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA message containing data for sections beyond the next main signal. The data for the section up to the next main signal in the infill message is different from the current MA, but the data beyond the next main signal is also different.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking information for the main signal balise group is available.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA message.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the infill information.

steps.action: Inspect the OBU's internal MA data for the section up to the next main signal.
steps.expected: The data for the section up to the next main signal remains unchanged from the previous MA (or is consistent with the non-infill part if applicable, but specifically, the requirement states 'all data beyond... shall be replaced', implying data before/at the reference is not replaced by the infill payload in the same way, or rather, the infill *is* the data beyond. Let's re-read: 'all data beyond the announced balise group... shall be replaced'. This implies the data *before* or *at* that point is not replaced by the infill message's content for those parts, or rather, the infill message *provides* the data beyond. The key is that the *previous* MA's data beyond that point is discarded and replaced by the new infill data. The data *before* that point in the previous MA should remain valid unless contradicted by other rules. Let's verify the 'beyond' part.

steps.action: Inspect the OBU's internal MA data for sections beyond the next main signal.
steps.expected: The data for sections beyond the next main signal has been replaced by the data from the infill MA. The previous MA's data for these sections is no longer present.

steps.expected: The OBU processes the infill information.

steps.action: Inspect the OBU's MA section structure.
steps.expected: A new MA section starts at the infill location reference (the balise group at the next main signal). The section before this reference remains as part of the previous MA structure or is handled according to the non-infill rules, but the new section explicitly begins at this reference.
